title: UNIQUBE OS Unified Estimation Rules and Cost Taxonomy

categories.name: SUBSTRUCTURE
categories.description: Below-grade and site-civil measured construction materials and subcontract services; earthworks, foundations, drainage under slabs

categories.name: SUPERSTRUCTURE
categories.description: Structural materials and bought-in structural assemblies, including approved LGS and precast components

categories.name: FINISHING
categories.description: Architectural finishes, building-envelope finishes, above-ground MEP materials and fixtures

categories.name: MANUFACTURING
categories.description: Direct factory operations, approved time standards, robotics, precast casting/curing, QA and productive machine energy

categories.name: WASTAGE
categories.description: Incremental discarded/irrecoverable material quantities from nesting, yield, procurement or damage; net of recovery

categories.name: LOGISTICS
categories.description: Packaging, dispatch, transportation, permits, international freight, delivery and returns

categories.name: INSTALLATION
categories.description: On-site erection, connection, lifting, site labour, temporary works, testing and handover

categories.name: OVERHEADS
categories.description: Non-direct project preliminaries, approved absorbed indirect costs, governance, financing and contingencies

categories.name: EXTERNAL COMMISSIONS
categories.description: Third-party agents and introducers with contractually eligible revenue bases and payout controls

categories.name: INTERNAL COMMISSIONS
categories.description: Authorised internal sales/performance incentives and payroll/finance controls

categories.name: PROFIT MARGINS
categories.description: Target profit, markup/margin conventions, quote pricing, floors, discount authorisations and margin monitoring

margin_note: Margin denominator is net sales; markup denominator is cost.

rules.name: Survey, boundaries and setting out
rules.logic: Count survey visits and control points per survey scope, not per floor area.
rules.check: Compare gridlines and site control to issued survey; missing benchmarks block layout.

rules.name: Site clearance, strip topsoil and demolition
rules.logic: Calculate union of work-area polygons; demolition volumes and disposal streams separately.
rules.check: Exclude protected zones and avoid overlapping polygons; classify waste types.

rules.name: Bulk cut and fill from terrain
rules.logic: Cut/fill = positive/negative difference between existing and design terrain surfaces integrated over work zone.
rules.check: Balance sections against 3D surface; no default ground level when survey missing.

rules.name: Foundation trench and pit excavation
rules.logic: Union actual pit/trench excavation solids including approved working space and batter; deduct overlaps.
rules.check: Check trench intersections, utilities and foundation depths against geotechnical report.

rules.name: Soil classification and excavation method
rules.logic: Allocate excavation volumes by approved soil/rock classification and excavation method.
rules.check: Unknown strata becomes provisional classification, not assumed soil class.

rules.name: Bulking, shrinkage and off-site haulage
rules.logic: Loose disposal volume = bank excavation volume × tested bulking factor; trips = ceil(weight or volume / legal payload).
rules.check: Exclude reused fill; apply truck volume AND legal weight constraints.

rules.name: Subgrade preparation and compaction
rules.logic: Measure prepared surface area; compacted layer volume = area × compacted thickness.
rules.check: Density testing frequency and achieved compaction per specification; failed tests trigger rework.

rules.name: Granular subbase and bedding
rules.logic: Net compacted volume = approved polygon area × placed compacted depth, minus exclusions.
rules.check: Purchased mass uses approved compacted density and supplier yield, not arbitrary fixed waste.

rules.name: Geotextile, separation layers and membranes
rules.logic: Installed area = surface coverage + designed laps, turns and anchors; purchased roll quantities by layout.
rules.check: Do not apply generic percentage where lap lengths are explicitly measurable.

rules.name: Dewatering, shoring and temporary support
rules.logic: Estimate pumped duration from approved construction programme; shoring face area from exposed excavation faces.
rules.check: Unknown groundwater/soil: provisional; structural temporary works require design approval.

rules.name: Isolated footing concrete / precast
rules.logic: Volume = sum approved 3D footing solids net of designed voids; count by type and revision.
rules.check: Footing dimensions and allowable bearing/settlement must come from approved structural design.

rules.name: Strip footing concrete
rules.logic: Volume = non-overlapping strip footing solids; junction overlaps counted once.
rules.check: Validate continuity and step levels against sections.

rules.name: Combined footing, raft and mat slab
rules.logic: Volume = approved solid model, including thickened zones and subtracting voids once.
rules.check: Cross-check plan area × average thickness with model and geotechnical design.

rules.name: Piles, pile caps and ground anchors
rules.logic: Pile length = approved cut-off to toe; cap volume = solids; reinforcement and anchors from schedules.
rules.check: No automatic pile count from building footprint; statutory pile tests accounted separately.

rules.name: Precast ground / tie beams
rules.logic: Measure each beam net profile × length excluding intersections modelled in adjacent solids.
rules.check: Check bearing, shear connectors and erection tolerances.

rules.name: Back-to-back 3mm LGS tie beams (provisional design)
rules.logic: Member mass = sum approved C-section cut lengths × certified kg/m + splice components.
rules.check: DO NOT assume two 3mm sections are sufficient: stiffness, buckling, uplift, corrosion and anchorage require engineered verification.

rules.name: Cast-in embedded LGS connectors / anchor plates
rules.logic: Count each approved embed assembly by footing and base-node ID; mass from fabricated plate/component model.
rules.check: Check load path, embed depth, edge distance, tolerance and corrosion protection; never infer from area.

rules.name: Anchor bolts, hold-downs and chemical anchors
rules.logic: Count from stamped anchorage schedule; separately track cast-in and post-installed anchors.
rules.check: Structural capacity and installation QC per design; no invented anchor spacing.

rules.name: Levelling pads, bearing shims and nonshrink grout
rules.logic: Pad and shim counts from bearing points; grout volume = bounded gap geometry minus inserts.
rules.check: Tolerance and minimum bearing per approved detail; adjust with as-built survey.

rules.name: Below-grade retaining walls and upstands
rules.logic: Concrete wall solids with openings; shuttering = exposed formed faces.
rules.check: Check drainage, earth pressure, waterproofing and retaining reinforcement.

rules.name: Ground-bearing slabs and edge thickenings
rules.logic: Base volume = net slab area × design thickness + distinct local thickening solids without overlaps.
rules.check: Verify soil and point loads, vapour barriers, joints and reinforcement.

rules.name: Ground floor damp-proof / vapour barrier
rules.logic: Membrane developed surface incl. upstands and specified laps; subtract qualified exclusions.
rules.check: Test continuity and exclude membrane already in composite slab assembly.

rules.name: Backfilling around foundations
rules.logic: Backfill = union excavated volume - below-ground occupied solids - excluded voids.
rules.check: Exclude imported granular layers counted under DIV01; separately track reuse/borrow fill.

rules.name: Substructure waterproofing and drainage interface
rules.logic: Below-grade faces in contact with soil × specified treatment; drain runs from approved drainage layout.
rules.check: Coordinate ownership with DIV09 waterproof layers and DIV12 drains to prevent double count.

rules.name: Precast substructure retaining/grade panels
rules.logic: Volume of approved precast solids including rebates; net of cast-in openings and pockets.
rules.check: Review earth pressure, temporary erection and base interfaces.

rules.name: Precast load-bearing wall panels
rules.logic: Net concrete solids by wall panel ID; retain gross elevation area separately.
rules.check: Validate structural wall schedule, tolerances, casting constraints and design connections.

rules.name: Non-load-bearing precast partitions
rules.logic: Net panel solids × type; joints and reveals separately.
rules.check: No load-bearing rating without structural classification.

rules.name: Precast beams, columns, lintels and stairs
rules.logic: Net parametric volume by structural element; stairs by flights, landings and inserts.
rules.check: Member design required; junction overlaps resolved by element ownership.

rules.name: Hollow-core floor/roof slabs
rules.logic: Count approved slab units; slab area by unit footprint; topping separately; supplier voided volume by unit type.
rules.check: Check bearings, diaphragm ties, fire/acoustic rating and openings.

rules.name: Precast reinforcement and mesh
rules.logic: Sum approved rebar bend schedule lengths × mass/m including laps/couplers; no area-based default as final quantity.
rules.check: If no rebar schedule, display provisional kg/m3 allowance clearly.

rules.name: Casting embeds, lifting anchors and sleeves
rules.logic: Count unique insert IDs from cast-in schedule per panel; estimate steel weight by CAD part model.
rules.check: Verify placement against MEP penetrations and lifting factors.

rules.name: Vertical wall-to-wall connections
rules.logic: Count approved detail by vertical seam location and load path; grout length/volume separately.
rules.check: Structural transfer, ductility, tolerances and erection sequence require approval.

rules.name: Horizontal wall-to-wall / floor connections
rules.logic: Count joint nodes and linear seams from approved connection schedule.
rules.check: Check progressive collapse/uplift and slab diaphragm path as applicable.

rules.name: Grout, bearing pads and joint sealants
rules.logic: Joint void solid volume for grout; sealant = approved exposed seam length; pads by bearings.
rules.check: Sealant and grout cannot both occupy the same joint cavity unless detailed layers distinguish them.

rules.name: Precast moulds, cycles and lifting/temporary braces
rules.logic: Cycle hours = setup + casting + curing occupancy + demould per mould family; braces by approved erection plan.
rules.check: Capacity constrained by mould availability, curing and crane, not only casting speed.

rules.name: Load-bearing wall system classification
rules.logic: Classify each wall segment by structural function and store gross and net areas; framing derived only after design.
rules.check: No architectural-only automatic load-bearing designation without approval.

rules.name: Primary structural studs and tracks
rules.logic: Sum engineered member cut lengths by section ID × manufacturer kg/m; separate top/bottom tracks.
rules.check: Check buckling, deflection, local capacity, bracing and service openings.

rules.name: Stud spacing and gauge selection
rules.logic: Generate member stations only from approved rule-set for wall type, height and design load, then convert to quantities.
rules.check: If loads missing, provisional framing ratio, not CNC-level final member count.

rules.name: Built-up studs, jambs and posts
rules.logic: Count additional pack studs/posts around opening and load points per structural detail.
rules.check: Do not use constant multiplier for all windows or doors.

rules.name: Headers, lintels, sills and cripple studs
rules.logic: Enumerate approved assemblies at each opening and size by span and load, including support studs.
rules.check: Lintel/span design and bearings approved before final.

rules.name: Nogging, blocking and lateral restraints
rules.logic: Take off restraint lines and solid blocks from approved bracing schedule.
rules.check: Do not infer framing restraint from board layers without validated system.

rules.name: Bracing / shear walls and hold-downs
rules.logic: Bracing straps/panels from lateral design; hold-down counts from load-path nodes.
rules.check: Must validate overturning/uplift and collector paths.

rules.name: Base tracks and foundation-to-LGS interfaces
rules.logic: Track lengths along approved support lines; anchors per stamped connection schedule.
rules.check: Corrosion isolation, base tolerance and uplift must be checked.

rules.name: LGS steel weight and purchased coil yield
rules.logic: Net member weight = Σ cut length × kg/m; purchased kg = net / verified coil/profile yield.
rules.check: Do not stack percentage waste over computed nesting scrap.

rules.name: CNC punch / notch / dimple and swage operations
rules.logic: Sum validated stations by member ID and operation type; machine minutes from approved cycle library.
rules.check: Check station spacing, length, tooling clearance and FDS restrictions.

rules.name: LGS fastening schedule
rules.logic: Count fasteners by approved joint type and station; distinguish temporary and permanent screws.
rules.check: Cross-check certified shear/pull-out capacities; no generic screws/m2 final.

rules.name: Structural design load cases and code pack
rules.logic: Record configuration of gravity, wind, seismic, serviceability and applicable local standards; design effort by complexity.
rules.check: Block manufacturing release unless code pack and responsible engineer approved.

rules.name: Internal standard LGS partitions
rules.logic: Net partition face area = wall length × height minus openings per deduction policy; sides count separately by layers.
rules.check: Do not equate net face m2 to steel kg; partition type assignment required.

rules.name: External infill / facade-backup framing
rules.logic: Measure framing zones; engineered/gauge-configured stud counts from support spans and cladding loads.
rules.check: Distinguish infill from structural load-bearing wall.

rules.name: Deflection-head/slip tracks and movement joints
rules.logic: Measure top-of-partition runs requiring movement detailing by slab deflection class.
rules.check: Do not use rigid head in specified deflection zones.

rules.name: Partition studs and tracks
rules.logic: Stud stations from approved spacing by partition type + boundary studs; member lengths adjusted for clearance.
rules.check: Walls may have varying height; exact member layout recorded per panel.

rules.name: Opening reinforcement and backing
rules.logic: Count per door/window frame opening type and service load; add fixture backing lines.
rules.check: Check WC/support rails and heavy equipment backing.

rules.name: Acoustic and fire-rated partition layers
rules.logic: Installed area by layer and side; insulation volume = cavity geometry × approved fill fraction.
rules.check: No arbitrary substitution of boards/insulation in tested fire assembly.

rules.name: Boards, screws and tapes
rules.logic: Boards by net layer area and sheet nesting; screws by grid and perimeter schedule; tape from joint layout.
rules.check: Subtract only allowable penetrations and record double-sided separate.

rules.name: MEP penetrations, service holes and reinforcements
rules.logic: Count penetrations from coordinated MEP model; steel alterations only through approved details.
rules.check: Check member net section and fire seals; detect clashes.

rules.name: Corners, intersections and junction detailing
rules.logic: Count special corner/junction assemblies by unique node IDs; trims by developed length.
rules.check: Prevent double-counting shared studs at common junction.

rules.name: Partition segmentation and panel IDs
rules.logic: Group wall segments into transport/robot envelope panels by deterministic panelisation rules.
rules.check: Preserve stable panel IDs across drawing revisions if unchanged.

rules.name: LGS floor joists and perimeter/rim tracks
rules.logic: Joists generated from approved span/load/spacing schedule; Σ cut length × kg/m; rim lengths from boundary.
rules.check: Structural checks on vibration, deflection, web crippling and bearing.

rules.name: Floor blocking, bridging and lateral restraint
rules.logic: Calculate joist restraint rows and blocks from engineered layout.
rules.check: No duplicated blocks where one element supports adjacent modules.

rules.name: Floor decking, boards and screeds
rules.logic: Area = net deck polygon; screed volume = area × design thickness plus falls zones.
rules.check: Deduct shafts/openings and check load/spanning specification.

rules.name: Floor diaphragm connections
rules.logic: Count diaphragm fasteners, blocking and boundary chords per lateral structural design.
rules.check: No final quantities without approved diaphragm details.

rules.name: Roof truss families and repetition
rules.logic: Truss count from approved bays; member cut lengths by truss type × repeated instances.
rules.check: Check uplift, local stability, member buckling and truss splice.

rules.name: Rafters, purlins and roof bridging
rules.logic: Count from roof slope and approved spacing; slope lengths not plan projection.
rules.check: Check bracing and cladding load case.

rules.name: Cantilevers, large openings and transfer members
rules.logic: Special structural steel assemblies by approved detail and geometry.
rules.check: Block final estimate without structural design; provisional distinct allowance.

rules.name: Stairs and landings in LGS
rules.logic: Count flights and landings; engineered member quantities and decking by plan/section.
rules.check: Comply with geometry, guardrail and loading requirements.

rules.name: Floor and roof bearing connections
rules.logic: Count distinct support-node IDs by engineered connection types.
rules.check: Check reactions, anchors, uplift and tolerances.

rules.name: Pod library, variants and repetitions
rules.logic: Count installed unique pod instances per type/revision; compare approved modular dimensions.
rules.check: Do not count pod envelope finishes again in DIV10/11/12/13.

rules.name: Pod precast/LGS base, floor pan and lifting frame
rules.logic: Take off from approved pod base member/solid models; lift points from engineered lifting plan.
rules.check: Validate transport, lift, stiffness and bearing interface.

rules.name: Pod wall/ceiling sheathing and insulation
rules.logic: Installed layer area from internal pod wall/ceiling geometry net permitted voids.
rules.check: Synchronise with tested moisture/fire/acoustic system.

rules.name: Waterproofing and wet-area details
rules.logic: Wet-area waterproofed surface + upstands/returns; joints by run.
rules.check: Perform flood testing allowance and overlap checks.

rules.name: Factory plumbing and drainage rough-in
rules.logic: Sum actual coordinated pod pipe and fitting runs; count penetrations and pre-installed fixtures.
rules.check: Exclude from building plumbing quantities except pod interface.

rules.name: Factory electrical and ventilation rough-in
rules.logic: Take off pod circuits, conduits, fan and fittings by model and device schedule.
rules.check: Verify external connection schedule and avoid building-service duplicate.

rules.name: Pod sanitary fittings and internal finishes
rules.logic: Fixtures by tagged schedule; finishes by developed area and layer.
rules.check: Count only if supplied within pod scope; scope reconciliation against DIV10-13.

rules.name: Pod factory QA, water/electrical tests
rules.logic: Tests by unit and type; labour time based on qualified inspection routes.
rules.check: Failed tests issue rework job, not free pass.

rules.name: Pod-to-building structural/MEP interfaces
rules.logic: Connections by interface node ID; building-side flexible links by physical route.
rules.check: Connection load path, seal and maintainability approved.

rules.name: Pod loading, packaging and handling
rules.logic: Packaging by pod instance; dispatch trips by payload/dimension and route constraints.
rules.check: Single charging owner under DIV17 for transport to site; pod factory package separate.

rules.name: Facade surface zoning and net cladding area
rules.logic: Sum unique facade finish polygons minus openings per material takeoff policy.
rules.check: Reconcile with walls and elevation tags; overlaps at corners assigned once.

rules.name: ACP and other rainscreen panels
rules.logic: Panel nesting from approved module grid; installed panel area, purchased sheet area and offcut waste separately.
rules.check: Check fire/combustibility specification and panel joint allowance.

rules.name: Sub-framing rails, brackets and anchors
rules.logic: Rails from approved grid runs; brackets/anchors from engineered spacing and support conditions.
rules.check: No bracket count solely from area for final quote.

rules.name: External sheathing and weather-resistive membranes
rules.logic: Installed developed area × layers, lap areas and returns by tested build-up.
rules.check: Check duplication with DIV05 integrated wall assembly.

rules.name: Thermal insulation, air barrier and thermal breaks
rules.logic: Insulation net area × thickness; thermal-break lengths at designed bracket interfaces.
rules.check: Thermal/moisture model or approved prescriptive construction controls selection.

rules.name: Windows, curtain wall and glazing
rules.logic: Count unique opening/window IDs by width×height, type and performance schedule.
rules.check: Reconcile counts across plans, elevations and schedules; procurement includes framing components.

rules.name: External doors, louvers and ventilation grilles
rules.logic: Count scheduled assemblies, gross opening geometry, and edge perimeter.
rules.check: Check security/fire/performance requirements.

rules.name: Facade cavity barriers and fire stopping
rules.logic: Linear barrier length along rated compartment lines + cavity details and penetrations.
rules.check: Must match tested system and local authority criteria.

rules.name: Flashings, copings, sills and sealant joints
rules.logic: Developed metal length/surface; sealant by joint run and cross-sectional design.
rules.check: Do not charge both window supplier and facade contractor for same sill.

rules.name: Facade access systems and testing
rules.logic: Scaffold/MEWP zones by elevation access plan; tests by approved plan.
rules.check: Check external access and testing responsibilities.

rules.name: Basement waterproof membranes and protection
rules.logic: Measure below-grade treated faces developed area + laps/upstands; protection boards separate.
rules.check: Check DIV02 ownership and leak-testing spec; groundwater design required.

rules.name: Below-slab vapour and water barriers
rules.logic: Net ground slab footprint + returns and laps, reconciled with DIV02 DPM.
rules.check: Single assembly owner prevents double counting.

rules.name: Roof primary substrate / fall-forming screed
rules.logic: Roof face area; variable-thickness screed by surface volume difference between elevations.
rules.check: Plan m2 is not slope-surface m2; check drainage minimum falls.

rules.name: Roof insulation and vapour control
rules.logic: Roof developed surface and insulation thickness per zone; laps and upstands.
rules.check: Check thermal bridging and moisture design.

rules.name: Roof waterproof membranes, upstands and terminations
rules.logic: Membrane face area + upstands + designed laps; terminations by linear run.
rules.check: Include penetration collars and mockups/testing; inspect details.

rules.name: Parapets, coping and edge flashings
rules.logic: Developed running lengths with profiles, returns and corners counted.
rules.check: Avoid duplication with DIV08 façade flashing/coping scope.

rules.name: Roof drains, gutters and downpipes
rules.logic: Outlet counts and gutter/downpipe lengths from designed rainwater network.
rules.check: Flow rates and outlet counts approved by MEP; interface with DIV12.

rules.name: Roof equipment plinths, walkway and protection
rules.logic: Count plinth solids/units and roof walking routes by approved equipment layout.
rules.check: Account equipment loads and plinth penetrations.

rules.name: Roof leak, flood and inspection testing
rules.logic: Test count from designated zones and site QC procedure; retesting tracked separately.
rules.check: No test release where roof penetration list remains open.

rules.name: Finished floor material zoning
rules.logic: Measure finish polygons per room and finish code, minus shafts; thresholds separately.
rules.check: Reconcile with pod finished area and exclusions.

rules.name: Screeds, levelling and falls
rules.logic: Volume = integrated design screed thickness across floor polygons; variable falls as solids.
rules.check: Floor slab allowance not counted twice.

rules.name: Floor tiles, stone and vinyl purchase yield
rules.logic: Purchased sheets/tiles = nesting layout or installed area / verified yield, rounded to packs.
rules.check: No double waste if sheet nesting already models cuts.

rules.name: Skirtings, thresholds and edge trims
rules.logic: Skirting = room boundary wall runs less excluded doors and built-ins; thresholds by door ID.
rules.check: Subtract openings/fixtures using finish policy.

rules.name: Internal wall skim/plaster/paint
rules.logic: Developed wall face area minus eligible openings; multiply separate coat count and sides.
rules.check: Wall board supplied under DIV05 not repeated here.

rules.name: Suspended ceilings, soffits and access panels
rules.logic: Ceiling polygons net service voids; support grid from manufacturer module rules; panels by schedule.
rules.check: Coordinate fixtures so no duplicate deductions.

rules.name: Wet-area wall tiles and accessories
rules.logic: Wall tiling = designated wall runs × tiled height minus exclusions; trims by exposed edges.
rules.check: Exclude factory-completed pod areas in DIV07.

rules.name: Joinery, counters, wardrobes and cabinets
rules.logic: Count scheduled shopfitted assemblies; linear/metred quantities by supplier convention.
rules.check: Provisional until shop drawings/supplier quote if unspecified.

rules.name: Internal doors, ironmongery and hardware
rules.logic: Unique door IDs per level and type; hardware sets according to rated/security group.
rules.check: Deduplicate plan symbols and door schedule entries.

rules.name: Finishes testing and snag/rework
rules.logic: Inspection area by work package; rework recorded as separate QA defect cost, not flat takeoff inflation.
rules.check: Maintain visibility of actual rework versus risk contingency.

rules.name: Below-grade HVAC/service sleeves and crossings
rules.logic: Count underground sleeves by service crossing ID; excavation/sleeve depth from coordination model.
rules.check: Civil penetration and service material have distinct owners.

rules.name: HVAC equipment (AHU, FCU, VRF, split)
rules.logic: Equipment counts and capacities from approved mechanical schedule, not just floor-area multipliers.
rules.check: Provisional only when mechanical design absent; energy capacity verified.

rules.name: Supply/return air ductwork
rules.logic: Duct developed sheet area = perimeter × developed centreline run + fitting development by fabrication rules.
rules.check: A nominal duct route length alone cannot generate fitting sheet quantity reliably.

rules.name: Duct insulation and liners
rules.logic: Developed external duct surface × insulation thickness or coverage as specified.
rules.check: Avoid counting factory-insulated duct as site lagging.

rules.name: Refrigerant, chilled-water and condensate piping
rules.logic: Take off coordinated centreline lengths by diameter/system; fittings by model or verified fittings schedule.
rules.check: Risers and offsets included; condensate fall constraints validated.

rules.name: Ventilation, extract, grilles and diffusers
rules.logic: Count schedule devices by system and flow; duct branches allocated separately.
rules.check: Capacity and fire/smoke dampers checked.

rules.name: Mechanical supports, access and vibration isolation
rules.logic: Supports from approved span and substrate rules; isolation per equipment selection.
rules.check: Check load to LGS/precast and access/maintenance clearance.

rules.name: Mechanical integration in factory wall/pod assemblies
rules.logic: Take off only interface sleeves/embedded routing by assembly ownership and MEP ID.
rules.check: No MEP element billed twice under DIV07 and DIV11.

rules.name: Mechanical testing, balancing and commissioning
rules.logic: Count system tests and TAB activities by equipment/zone; durations from approved method statements.
rules.check: Documentation and handover requirements tracked.

rules.name: Underground foul/storm drainage pipes
rules.logic: 3D pipe runs measured centreline by nominal diameter; fittings/manholes tracked separately.
rules.check: Validate slopes, clashes and outfall levels.

rules.name: External potable water and fire-main buried pipes
rules.logic: Pipe centreline by size/material; trench/bedding linked via civil assembly without repeating excavation.
rules.check: Flow/pressure and corrosion protection approved.

rules.name: Manholes, catch pits, soakaways and chambers
rules.logic: Unique chamber count and detailed concrete/brick solids by type.
rules.check: Exclude chamber excavation where DIV01 already counts pit excavation.

rules.name: Hot/cold water domestic pipework
rules.logic: Coordinated pipe centreline lengths × type/diameter; devices by tagged fixture ID.
rules.check: Allow pipe fitting losses through fitting schedule not blanket margin.

rules.name: Soil/waste/vent stacks and branch drains
rules.logic: Count vertical rises and horizontal branches by diameter incl. bends, cleanouts and slopes.
rules.check: Check traps, vent continuity and fall to inverts.

rules.name: Sanitary fixtures, taps and accessories
rules.logic: Unique fixture schedules per building/room; pod-contained fixtures assigned to pod assembly.
rules.check: Cross-check sanitary symbols, schedules and procurement packages.

rules.name: Water heaters, tanks and pumps
rules.logic: Capacities and counts from demand and approved equipment schedule.
rules.check: Fallback allowances clearly provisional until MEP design.

rules.name: Plumbing supports, sleeves and fire collars
rules.logic: Hangers by support rule and route; sleeves/collars by rated penetration IDs.
rules.check: Fire sealing ownership coordinated with DIV14.

rules.name: Plumbing pressure, flushing and leak tests
rules.logic: Test segments by pressure-zone and system type; test time from procedure.
rules.check: Failed testing produces rework and retest entry.

rules.name: Underground electrical ducts and cable corridors
rules.logic: Centreline routes by duct bank type; chamber crossings separately.
rules.check: Exclude trench concrete and earthworks counted as civil.

rules.name: Earthing grids, buried rods and bonds
rules.logic: Measure copper conductor centreline and unique rod/pit locations by approved earthing plan.
rules.check: Earth resistance/testing required, no rods/m2 blanket rule.

rules.name: MDB, SMDB, DB and control panels
rules.logic: Count by switchgear schedule and distribution hierarchy.
rules.check: Ratings/protection selectivity required for final.

rules.name: Cable trays, ladders, conduits and trunking
rules.logic: Measure containment centreline by type/size; bends, junctions and supports separately.
rules.check: Cross-check coordinated routing and permitted fill.

rules.name: Power cables and conductors
rules.logic: Route length × cores with slack, termination tails and pull allowances per approved wiring rule.
rules.check: Voltage drop, cable fill, current capacity and fault ratings checked.

rules.name: Lighting fixtures, switches and sockets
rules.logic: Count each uniquely tagged device by fixture/circuit schedule and room plan.
rules.check: Avoid duplicate count between plan and schedules.

rules.name: Low current, security, data and CCTV
rules.logic: Device schedules + data cabling centreline by system; racks and containment separately.
rules.check: Check headend capacity, cable category and device power.

rules.name: Emergency lighting and fire alarm wiring
rules.logic: Devices by fire design and loop; wiring as separate circuit lengths.
rules.check: System interface with DIV14; assign lead owner to avoid duplicate.

rules.name: Factory prewired panel/pod electrical interfaces
rules.logic: Prewired device runs assigned by assembly ID; site plug/harness interfaces separate.
rules.check: Prevent embedded cable counted twice under DIV07/16.

rules.name: Electrical tests, energisation and commissioning
rules.logic: Test circuit counts and system functions; inspection/test activity by protocol.
rules.check: Inspection certificates and as-built IDs required.

rules.name: Below-grade fire mains, chambers and penetrations
rules.logic: Count underground fire lines/chambers, using DIV12 service routing and separate rated penetrations.
rules.check: Ensure ownership between fire network and water mains.

rules.name: Fire resistance classification and assembly schedules
rules.logic: Map rated wall, floor, door and roof assemblies to approved tested construction system IDs.
rules.check: Cannot claim A1/A2, fire resistance or test rating without relevant evidence.

rules.name: Fire-rated board and mineral wool layers
rules.logic: Count per tested assembly layer including side/layer counts; deduct as approved.
rules.check: Link to DIV05/08 to prevent charging board twice.

rules.name: Fire stopping at joints and penetrations
rules.logic: Fire seal joints by running length and service penetration IDs by substrate/system.
rules.check: Use certified seal system and size/annulus limits.

rules.name: Fire doors, dampers and access hatches
rules.logic: Count uniquely tagged rated openings and air system dampers by schedule.
rules.check: Avoid duplication with normal door and mechanical rates.

rules.name: Sprinkler mains, branches and heads
rules.logic: Hydraulically designed pipe network lengths and head count by type and location.
rules.check: No sprinkler/head count solely by m2 as final.

rules.name: Hose reels, extinguishers and cabinets
rules.logic: Count from approved life-safety schedules and exit/coverage design.
rules.check: Authority approvals and coverage distances checked.

rules.name: Detectors, strobes, alarms and controls
rules.logic: Count design devices and control loops, taking component ownership from DIV13.
rules.check: Do not double count same device under electrical package.

rules.name: Emergency exit signs and escape lighting
rules.logic: Count from reviewed egress plans and lux/visibility calculations.
rules.check: Route coverage and emergency circuit design validated.

rules.name: Fire system testing, approvals and certification
rules.logic: Count integrated tests, authority inspections, witnessing and certificate submissions.
rules.check: Cannot mark as accepted without documented approvals.

rules.name: External sewer and stormwater network
rules.logic: Pipe runs, invert levels, manholes and catch pits from coordinated civil utility model.
rules.check: Link trench excavation to DIV01 and underground drainage pipes to DIV12 by package ownership.

rules.name: External potable/fire utility and telecom connections
rules.logic: Service routes from boundary point to plant, by size and utility provider design.
rules.check: Provisional where utility authority connection information missing.

rules.name: Roads, pavement, kerbs and hardscape
rules.logic: Pavement layer polygons and compacted thickness per layer; kerbs by alignment length.
rules.check: Do not combine compacted base and surface thickness into single material.

rules.name: Boundary, retaining and landscape walls
rules.logic: Wall length, height and construction-system quantities by engineered type and junctions.
rules.check: Deduplicate retaining walls in DIV02/03.

rules.name: Landscaping, topsoil, planting and irrigation
rules.logic: Areas by landscape zone; topsoil m3 = net area × depth; plants by schedule; irrigation pipes by routes.
rules.check: Exclude building footprints and avoid duplicate irrigation networks.

rules.name: External lighting, bollards and utility accessories
rules.logic: Count fixture IDs and wiring routes; circuits by schedule.
rules.check: Check scope with DIV13 underground duct and earthing.

rules.name: Septic/soakaway tanks and site water structures
rules.logic: Count tank solids and bedding/insulation by approved chamber family.
rules.check: Approval/design-dependent; do not extrapolate from population alone.

rules.name: External site grading and finished levels
rules.logic: 3D surface difference from approved finish terrain vs formation, net of building and restricted zones.
rules.check: Cross-check DIV01 cut/fill; assign unique earthwork ownership.

rules.name: Utility connection and inspection fees
rules.logic: Use authority quotations or published tariffs with revision date, not geometric proxy.
rules.check: Commercial provisional until authority offer received.

rules.name: Manufacturing panelisation and dimension envelope
rules.logic: Partition approved wall solids into uniquely identified manufacturable panels within machine, transport and lifting limits.
rules.check: No segmented panel without continuity and joint approval.

rules.name: Repeat families, standardisation and programme reuse
rules.logic: Hash geometry+materials+ops+revision to family ID; one qualified CNC programme per identical unit with repeat count.
rules.check: Different penetrations/MEP positions must trigger distinct family/operation IDs.

rules.name: LGS coil nesting / purchased metal yield
rules.logic: Purchased mass from generated cutlist optimisation and proven coil yield; scrap recorded separately.
rules.check: No generic steel wastage percentage on top of actual nesting.

rules.name: Board sheet nesting, orientation and purchased yield
rules.logic: Optimise placed cut polygons into board sheets respecting orientation, joints and machine constraints.
rules.check: Fire assembly board joints orientation retained.

rules.name: CNC operation validation (Mulk Marses)
rules.logic: Map approved member crosses/holes to machine operation coordinates and station types; validate executable restrictions.
rules.check: Check negative coordinates, conflicting operations, gauge/tool compatibility and program revision.

rules.name: Robot cycle time by station
rules.logic: Cycle = load + position + cut/punch + fasten + sheath + MEP stages + transfer + verified waits per panel.
rules.check: Critical-path concurrency; do not sum parallel tasks sequentially.

rules.name: Manual labour and MEP integration
rules.logic: Standard work content × panel/pod count adjusted for complexity and learning curve calibrated to actuals.
rules.check: Avoid optimistic theoretical robot throughput as labour productivity.

rules.name: Precast mould utilisation and curing
rules.logic: Required mould slots = mould occupancy time × unit count, constrained by mould count and curing cycle.
rules.check: Check concrete strength release, lift slot and shift capacity.

rules.name: Factory QC and rework allowance
rules.logic: Mandatory inspections per unit and hold point; defect rework charged separately using defect records.
rules.check: Mandatory compliance tests not eliminated by historic low defect rate.

rules.name: QR panel identity and factory traceability
rules.logic: One digital identity for each shipped unit; parent link to assembly, design and CNC revision.
rules.check: Barcode collision and orphan records block dispatch.

rules.name: Factory packing, racking and stock handling
rules.logic: Rack allocations from panel dimensions, stacking hierarchy and lift equipment; packaging by dispatched unit.
rules.check: Do not duplicate transport A-frame rental in DIV17.

rules.name: Production capacity and sequencing constraints
rules.logic: Production duration = resource-constrained schedule across bottleneck stations/shifts/curing, not total area / nameplate speed.
rules.check: Use actual OEE with planned maintenance and first-article validation.

rules.name: Factory-to-site panel/pod logistics units
rules.logic: 3D packing plan with axle weight, dimensional and stack limits; dispatch count rounded to trips.
rules.check: Truck volume alone insufficient: apply legal weight/width/height constraints.

rules.name: Temporary A-frame racks, crates and protection
rules.logic: Rack and packaging counts by piece load plan and return cycle; rentable days from delivery schedule.
rules.check: Owner assignment of factory handling vs site/transport rental.

rules.name: Crane size, lifts and duration
rules.logic: Lift weights/radii and approved lift plan determine crane class; hours by lift cycle + setup + waits.
rules.check: Crane class cannot be computed from number of panels alone; engineered lift plan required.

rules.name: Installation sequence and crew productivity
rules.logic: Σ validated task time by panel/pod type adjusted for site height, access and repetition.
rules.check: Account starter panels, alignment, tolerance and learning curve.

rules.name: Temporary bracing and access equipment
rules.logic: Count engineered temporary supports and working-platform duration from erection plan.
rules.check: Structural stability during construction is an engineering gate.

rules.name: Site anchoring, bolting, grout and seals
rules.logic: Installed connections by unique structural node ID and approved detail; grout by joint solids.
rules.check: Assign precast grout to DIV03 or erection package, not both.

rules.name: Delivery distances, road restrictions and permits
rules.logic: Actual approved route kilometres × truck trips; oversize permit items from dimension/weight rules.
rules.check: No nominal flat freight if escort/custom clearance is required.

rules.name: Site QC, alignment surveys and inspections
rules.logic: Checkpoints per unit and floor, plus final alignment/as-built records.
rules.check: Deviation outside tolerance requires RFI/rework cost, not silent approval.

rules.name: Weather/calendar and site preliminaries
rules.logic: Site duration from feasible task calendar including defined restrictions and weather risk as a separate allowance.
rules.check: Keep cost contingency separate from physical base quantity.

rules.name: Master rate-card and currency versions
rules.logic: Every pricing line linked to material/labour/equipment SKU, source, date, currency and region.
rules.check: Expired rates and missing rates flagged; currency conversion date stored.

rules.name: Net-installed vs fabricated vs purchased quantities
rules.logic: Store net installed, fabricated gross and purchased rounded quantity separately by rule, with waste bridge.
rules.check: No waste added twice; zero purchase when owner-supplied explicitly recorded.

rules.name: Direct material, labour and machine cost
rules.logic: Direct = Σ purchased qty×unit material price + Σ hours×loaded rates + Σ machine-hours×machine rate.
rules.check: All component rates assigned one cost owner and scope.

rules.name: Subcontract and vendor quote mapping
rules.logic: Use evaluated vendor quote amount by defined scope IDs, with escalation and tax basis separately.
rules.check: Comparison checks that quoted scope is identical to required design.

rules.name: Project preliminaries and site running cost
rules.logic: Time-related preliminaries = duration×resource/day; fixed preliminaries explicitly scheduled.
rules.check: Do not distribute lump sum per m2 as underlying physical quantity.

rules.name: Indirect factory overhead and depreciation
rules.logic: Absorption = productive machine/factory hours × validated cost rate with chosen accounting treatment.
rules.check: Do not include depreciation both in machine rate and OH markup.

rules.name: Risk, contingencies and design uncertainty
rules.logic: Risk reserve = sum(item-specific likelihood×impact or approved risk allowance); excluded from base quantities.
rules.check: Provisional flag never converted silently to engineered quantity.

rules.name: Corporate overhead, profit and pricing margin
rules.logic: Apply pricing method to defined cost base: sell price = cost/(1-target gross margin) if margin on sales.
rules.check: Distinguish margin on sales from markup on cost.

rules.name: Regional codes, taxes and import duties
rules.logic: Tax/duty by line-specific jurisdictional rate and documented trade rules, from price base.
rules.check: Rates must be externally maintained and dated; no fixed universal percentages.

rules.name: Price escalation and exchange exposure
rules.logic: Forecast escalation applied by procurement date and contracted index/FX assumption.
rules.check: Show base and escalated price separately; no double inflation of rate card.

rules.name: Revisions, deltas and audit trail
rules.logic: Recompute affected assemblies on revision event; compare old/new quantities and prices by stable IDs.
rules.check: Unchanged geometry retains IDs; approvals reset when upstream engineering changes.

rules.name: Quotations, inclusions and exclusions
rules.logic: Aggregate priced work-breakdown items for substructure and superstructure with separate provisional schedules.
rules.check: No release when unpriced required line, unresolved duplicate or missing design gate exists.

rules.name: Accuracy benchmarking and actual-cost feedback
rules.logic: Compare approved manual baseline, tender and as-built actual: variance=(estimated-verified)/verified.
rules.check: Use item-level and value-weighted errors; segregate scope variation from quantity error.

rules.name: HVAC design zones and room load reconciliation
rules.logic: Equipment schedule load by served zone; reconcile sum of approved room sensible/latent loads to served capacity; do not infer installed capacity from floor area alone.
rules.check: Flag absent loads, mismatched zone assignments, undersized or duplicated capacity; licensed MEP approval required.

rules.name: Air-conditioning indoor/outdoor equipment
rules.logic: Count unique scheduled AHU/FCU/VRF indoor/outdoor equipment IDs; record rated kW and accessories per tagged type.
rules.check: Location/access/structural mounting, service clearances and matched system capacity must reconcile.

rules.name: Rectangular and circular duct straight lengths
rules.logic: Σ unique duct segment centreline lengths by type, section and pressure class; exposed skin area Σ segment_perimeter × developed_length; bends/fittings separately by model.
rules.check: Exclude fitting lengths already included in straight segment endpoints; validate clash and level route.

rules.name: Duct fittings, transitions and accessories
rules.logic: Count elbows, tees, transitions and dampers by unique BIM IDs; developed sheet area from approved pattern/model, not blanket percentage of duct length.
rules.check: Duct fitting costs are not duplicated inside straight duct material rate.

rules.name: Duct insulation and vapour barrier
rules.logic: Insulation net coverage = sum external duct developed surfaces including fitting skins, less exposed no-insulate areas; purchased rolls/sheets = net / approved nesting or coverage yield rounded to packs.
rules.check: Specify inside/outside insulation and fire performance; avoid duct/insulation composite-rate duplication.

rules.name: Duct hangers, vibration mounts and supports
rules.logic: Count engineered support locations from spans, equipment and load paths; special trapezes/isolators from approved schedule.
rules.check: No fixed support quantity per m without approved design spacing; coordinate LGS backing.

rules.name: Diffusers, grilles and air terminals
rules.logic: Count unique terminal IDs by type and size from coordination model/air-device schedule; accessory count by terminal family.
rules.check: Check return/supply/exhaust distinct and diffuser quantities against room schedule.

rules.name: Refrigerant/chilled-water pipework and fittings
rules.logic: Σ modelled supply and return routes, vertical rises, valve bypasses and terminal connections per pipe size; fittings/insulation and purchased packs separately.
rules.check: Do not double count supply+return; require hydraulic/refrigerant specification approval.

rules.name: Ventilation fans, exhaust and fresh-air intakes
rules.logic: Count equipment IDs by rated air flow; associated supports, louvres, ducts and controls via relationships not repeat counts.
rules.check: Ventilation performance and duct pressure must be approved, not inferred from screenshots.

rules.name: Condensate drains, traps and insulation
rules.logic: Sum approved condensate pipe runs by size and gradient; traps/pumps from appliance connection schedule.
rules.check: Check gravity fall versus elevations; count pump only if specified; plumbing owner allocated.

rules.name: HVAC controls and BMS points
rules.logic: Count unique sensor, thermostat, actuator, input/output and controller point IDs from control schedules; cable runs separately by electrical owner.
rules.check: Control point count must reconcile equipment capabilities; avoid BAS package duplication.

rules.name: Plant and equipment bases, plinths and sleeves
rules.logic: Count approved base/plinth geometry and equipment sleeves; allocate civil concrete and LGS framing to owner divisions via unique component IDs.
rules.check: Below/above-grade allocation from physical location, double-check embedded supports and slab openings.

rules.name: Underground water supply and fire-supply interfaces
rules.logic: Σ surveyed/design-approved below-grade centreline pipe lengths by size and material plus valves/chambers by ID; trenches counted by civil owner.
rules.check: Exclude trench excavations counted DIV01/15; pressure classes and material approved.

rules.name: Underground foul/sewer/storm drain network
rules.logic: Σ gravity pipe centrelines grouped by diameter, gradient and invert; manholes, catch basins and connection pits by ID.
rules.check: Positive gravity slope checks, underground clash, chamber depth and trench ownership.

rules.name: Foundation/ground slab MEP penetrations
rules.logic: Count unique service-to-foundation/slab crossing IDs; sleeves, puddle flanges, fire seals and waterproof collars by detail.
rules.check: No unapproved penetration through footing/tie beam; structural waterproofing approval.

rules.name: Potable hot/cold water distribution
rules.logic: Route length Σ segments including risers and branches, each system and size separately; fittings from fittings graph and valve schedule.
rules.check: Do not derive final pipe size from floor area; hot water circulation separate from supply.

rules.name: Internal soil, waste and vent network
rules.logic: Σ routed soil/waste/vent centreline segments by nominal size; branches and traps count from fixture connections; stacks counted once.
rules.check: Check invert clearance in floor assemblies and falls; no duplicate riser counts between floors.

rules.name: Sanitary fixture and tapware schedule
rules.logic: Count each uniquely tagged WC, basin, shower, sink, tap and floor drain; expand to approved accessory/connection kits.
rules.check: Subtract factory-installed pod contents from site supply; fixture IDs must reconcile to rooms.

rules.name: Water pumps, heaters, tanks and treatment
rules.logic: Count approved equipment IDs with capacity and quantity per hydraulic schedule; accessories from approved vendor pack lists.
rules.check: Equipment sizing and redundancy design require engineering, not rough building-area factors.

rules.name: Pipe insulation, heat tracing and cladding
rules.logic: Σ approved pipe length by OD+insulation thickness and pipe family; developed insulation area = π×outer_insulated_diameter×length (fitting allowances explicit).
rules.check: Exclude uninsulated pipe and avoid duplicating vendor pre-insulated pipe.

rules.name: Plumbing pressure/leak testing and commissioning
rules.logic: Test zones count from isolated system boundaries, test specifications and test sequence; hours from approved productivity standards.
rules.check: Test pressure/time and acceptance prescribed by design authority; retesting separately flagged.

rules.name: Underground power and ELV duct banks
rules.logic: Σ distinct duct-bank centreline by section type × duct ways; chambers and pull boxes by unique ID, trench civil costs referenced once.
rules.check: Bend radius, burial cover and civil trench owner validated before release.

rules.name: Earth electrodes, buried conductors and pits
rules.logic: Σ engineered earthing grid conductor lengths and unique pit/rod IDs; conductor size from approved schedule.
rules.check: Earthing resistance/touch potential needs approved design and test; no rod-per-area assumptions.

rules.name: Distribution boards, switchgear and busbars
rules.logic: Count uniquely tagged electrical panels and equipment by approved single-line diagram; busbar/breakers from approved BOM.
rules.check: Circuit ratings, selectivity and fault level approved; avoid counting switchgear within packaged modules.

rules.name: Circuit cable and wiring takeoff
rules.logic: Σ (approved routed segment length + riser drops + explicit terminal slack) per circuit and conductor/core; cores and parallel runs reflected in purchased conductor length.
rules.check: Check one-way vs return conductors, voltage drop and segregation; cable sold by metre/drum not area.

rules.name: Conduits, cable trays and trunking
rules.logic: Σ distinct containment segment lengths by cross-section and size; bends/tees/reducers and supports by approved model/schedule.
rules.check: Ensure raceway fill/spacing code checks and avoid double-counting with factory-integrated wall services.

rules.name: Lights, switches, sockets and devices
rules.logic: Count unique fixture/outlet/switch IDs by room and type; include compatible boxes, faceplates and accessories from product BOM.
rules.check: Coordinate exact placements within LGS panels and finished surfaces; pod devices factory cost owner.

rules.name: Lighting control, emergency power and exit signage
rules.logic: Count addressed luminaires/controls, emergency devices, UPS/generator links and signs from approved life-safety schedule.
rules.check: Emergency run times and sign positions subject to authority approval.

rules.name: Data, CCTV, access control and low-current
rules.logic: Unique ELV device and network point IDs; cable routes from approved topology plus drops/slack; racks/active devices by design list.
rules.check: Do not imply surveillance coverage by arbitrary device-per-area rules; check segregation.

rules.name: Factory-integrated electrical wall kits
rules.logic: Per unique panel ID expand junction boxes, conduits, grommets, sleeves and wiring kits from frozen integrated MEP design; route purchased materials to MEP, labour to factory.
rules.check: Exclude duplicate site conduits/devices; retain tested product compliance and access.

rules.name: Buried fire mains and hydrants
rules.logic: Distinct buried firefighting mains by diameter and fitting type; unique hydrants/chambers by IDs; civil excavation referenced but not charged twice.
rules.check: Design authority signoff; reconcile site mains vs water supply mains.

rules.name: Sprinkler heads, piping and zone valves
rules.logic: Approved head layout count by type, piping routed length by diameter, valve set count by zone; design validated by hydraulic calculations.
rules.check: Sprinkler count cannot be safely inferred from m² only; code/system design approval.

rules.name: Fire alarm loop devices and panels
rules.logic: Count unique fire detection/notification devices and interface modules; loops from fire alarm cause-and-effect/design, cables from route model.
rules.check: Addressable point limits, survivability and cause-effect requirements reviewed.

rules.name: Hose reels, extinguishers and cabinets
rules.logic: Count scheduled fire equipment IDs by location; cabinet and mounting hardware by product pack.
rules.check: Occupancy, travel distance and authority design checks mandatory.

rules.name: Firestopping of MEP penetrations
rules.logic: Count service penetrations by host assembly rating, diameter/type and listed tested firestop system; fire-rated linear joints separately.
rules.check: One owner only for opening treatment; wet waterproof sealing and fire seal may be separate line only when physically distinct.

rules.name: Smoke control and pressurisation equipment
rules.logic: Count approved fans, dampers, control interfaces and duct routes by smoke control design; no schematic-only numeric assumptions.
rules.check: Performance, pressure, standby power and authority approvals mandatory.

rules.name: Fire-rated access and service doors
rules.logic: Count fire-rated door/hatch assets from door schedule and rated compartment/shaft interfaces.
rules.check: Do not duplicate architectural door price; cost owner depends on parent assembly contract.

rules.name: MEP pod/volumetric scope interface
rules.logic: Count unique pod interface connections (hot/cold, waste, supply/exhaust, electrical/data) from interface control documents; factory-contained work excluded from site scope.
rules.check: No site double counting of packaged pod piping, finishes or fixtures; test ownership defined.

rules.name: Floor finish type zoning and net area
rules.logic: Σ unique room finish polygons minus design exclusions and voids; door thresholds and transitions separate by approved measurement rule.
rules.check: No overlap of tiled rooms and completed pod floor; finish code and drawing revision reconcile.

rules.name: Tile modular cutting and purchase yield
rules.logic: Installed tiled area from pattern-layout solver; purchased tile count = ceil((whole tiles + cut/waste tiles)/tiles_per_box) by SKU and lot.
rules.check: Waste from layout/nesting and breakage policy explicit; never add blanket waste again.

rules.name: Floor screeds and variable falls
rules.logic: Volume = integral[approved screed thickness(x,y) dA] over net floor polygon; edge details and slope screeds explicit.
rules.check: Reject negative thickness or incompatible finished-floor levels; site/factory ownership.

rules.name: Underlays, acoustic mat and vapour control
rules.logic: Installed membrane/underlay = covered floor polygons plus detailed laps/upstands; purchased = patterned coverage/yield rounded to rolls.
rules.check: Overlaps measured in purchased supply not same as net floor coverage; acoustic ratings require tested assembly.

rules.name: Skirtings, edge strips and thresholds
rules.logic: Net skirting length = perimeter of eligible finish zones minus door clear openings + approved returns; threshold IDs separately.
rules.check: Room shared walls not double counted for same face; corners and returns recorded.

rules.name: Floor expansion and movement joints
rules.logic: Σ engineered joint line lengths intersecting finish zones; each joint typed by profile and movement requirement.
rules.check: Joints aligned to structural requirements; no generic spacing for engineered/large tile systems.

rules.name: Resin, vinyl, carpet, stone and timber finishes
rules.logic: Each finish system = distinct installed polygon area with separate layers (primer, adhesive, finish) and purchase yield by roll/slab/pack.
rules.check: Do not apply tile waste assumptions to resin or sheet flooring; substrate tolerance reviewed.

rules.name: Wall paint and coatings
rules.logic: Net paint area = Σ eligible wall-face areas less allowed openings + reveals/returns; material litres = net_area×coats/validated_coverage_per_litre adjusted for application loss.
rules.check: Coating coverage to depend on substrate and DFT; fire/weather claims need approved system.

rules.name: Wall plaster, skim and putty
rules.logic: Area = treated net wall-face area plus reveals; volume = Σ area×approved average thickness (or thickness map); purchased via mix yield.
rules.check: No plaster where finished cement boards do not require plaster; layer compatibility.

rules.name: Internal ceramic/stone wall cladding
rules.logic: Net tiled wall faces by finish zone + reveals; purchase by tile layout, orientation, cuts, grout width and supplier cartons.
rules.check: Wall finishes inside prefabricated pods excluded from site estimate; waterproof layer separately owned.

rules.name: Suspended ceiling areas and grids
rules.logic: Net ceiling polygon (excluding open voids) × tile/board layers; grid main/cross tees and hanger quantities derived from approved layout and spans.
rules.check: Ceiling supports and MEP openings coordinated; engineer approval for special spans.

rules.name: Gypsum/cement board ceiling, bulkheads and soffits
rules.logic: Boarded area = net ceiling planes + developed bulkhead vertical faces + soffit faces; framing and screws from approved assembly grid.
rules.check: No generic per m² fastening for rated/structural ceilings; overlaps checked.

rules.name: Corner beads, trims and plaster joints
rules.logic: Sum unique positive/negative corners, exposed board edges and control-joint paths subject to finish assembly inclusions.
rules.check: Do not count concealed corners or trims bundled in panel kits.

rules.name: Façade cladding and substrate finishes
rules.logic: Σ facade panel face polygons excluding defined apertures; derive purchased modules and subframe brackets from approved façade engineered layout.
rules.check: Keep ACP supply/installation distinct from structural LGS wall and window flashing.

rules.name: Wet area membrane and upstand returns
rules.logic: Membrane coverage = floor wet zone + wetted wall upstands + pipe collars + lap areas; procurement follows sheet/roll layout.
rules.check: At pod wet areas scope owner POD; test continuity at drains/thresholds.

rules.name: Wet-area falls, niches, kerbs and shower bases
rules.logic: Develop slope surface polygons and local screed solids; niche/kerb/threshold components count by unique wet-area detail IDs.
rules.check: Positive drainage and minimum required waterproofing continuity verified.

rules.name: Internal doors, frames and hardware sets
rules.logic: Count door instance IDs by leaf/frame/fire/acoustic type; explode approved door set into leaves, frame, hinges, locks, closers, seals.
rules.check: Fire-rated door schedule reconciles DIV14; no duplicate rated door price.

rules.name: External glazing, windows and doors
rules.logic: Window/door counts and measured clear/frame areas from approved elevations and schedules; glass, framing, gaskets, fixings by tested system rules.
rules.check: Check thermal and safety glazing, weather seal and structural fixing; no opening area-only final system cost.

rules.name: Window and door perimeter sealant/flashings
rules.logic: Develop perimeter line lengths by side according to detail; include sill pans, head flashings, jamb tapes and sealant bead cross-section.
rules.check: Exclude factory-installed components of completed façade panels; no sealant missing at return corners.

rules.name: Kitchen cabinetry, wardrobes and fitted furniture
rules.logic: Count cabinet modules by schedule; carcass sheet area via parametric module BOM, front finish per developed face, countertop length/slab nesting separately.
rules.check: Exclude loose furniture; verify room and pod/joinery owner.

rules.name: Stair finishes, nosings and handrails
rules.logic: Sum tread/riser/landing finish area from staircase geometry; nosings = finished step count×run width; handrails from approved paths.
rules.check: Guard load and accessibility require approved design; exclude structural stair concrete.

rules.name: Below-grade protective coatings and protection boards
rules.logic: Coverage = net soil-facing waterproofed surface plus approved overlaps, turn-ups and terminations; protection board supply from board layout.
rules.check: Waterproofing structural/finishes cost owner determined by contract; exclude previously costed tanking.

rules.name: Roof terrace screed, membrane and paving
rules.logic: Layer-specific roof solids/polygons: slope screed volume, roof membrane developed area incl. laps/upstands, pavers by laying pattern.
rules.check: Avoid duplicates between roof waterproofing DIV09 and finishing rates.

rules.name: Finish mockups, samples and testing
rules.logic: Count approved sample/finish system mock-ups per unique finish class and contract approval; testing volume from inspection-and-test plan.
rules.check: Sample/production area not automatically both charged unless approved consumptive mockup.

rules.name: Snagging, protection and rework allowance
rules.logic: Baseline snag labour from reviewed productivity and package complexity; rework only from documented defect rate/scenario, not hidden in area quantity.
rules.check: Keep rework and contingency visible; no duplicate material waste or blanket rework surcharge.

rules.name: Factory-installed pod finishes ownership
rules.logic: Allocate in-pod boards, waterproofing, tiles, paint and fixture finishes to pod BOM; site FIN lines only for corridor tie-ins/interfaces.
rules.check: Invoice once; component IDs linked to manufactured pod; room schedule reconciles.

rules.name: Façade insulation, barrier and cavity firestops
rules.logic: Insulation/net barrier developed areas from facade faces; firestop lengths at floor lines/openings/joints per tested assembly layout.
rules.check: Ownership between finish and fire system explicit; fire classification not inferred from material only.

rules.name: Acoustic, fire and thermal ceiling build-ups
rules.logic: Layers by tested ceiling assembly: net ceiling face × board layers plus scheduled mineral wool density×volume; hangers from tested design.
rules.check: No claims without exact tested system/design and QA records.

rules.name: Production package release and revision freeze
rules.logic: Create immutable manufacturing packet by assembly IDs, engineer approval, BOM version, CAM file checksums and schedule; no quantities added.
rules.check: Block shop-floor release when any referenced artifact is newer than approved packet.

rules.name: Panel family standardisation and repeat programmes
rules.logic: Canonical hash(profile geometry, holes, openings, MEP penetrations, op order, material, revision) → family; unique programme count = unique family IDs.
rules.check: Non-identical members/panels cannot share CNC programme because of reused visible shape alone.

rules.name: LGS coil nesting and steel purchased quantity
rules.logic: Σ approved member blank/cut lengths × certified kg/m + measurable punch/trim offcuts; purchase by coil width/mass/yield and supplier MOQ.
rules.check: Theoretical wall area cannot set gauge/profile; track scrap separate from gross steel input.

rules.name: Steel member cut, punch, dimple, notch operations
rules.logic: Operation sequence per member from approved CAM routing; time=sum operation-specific validated machine cycle coefficients plus handling and tool changes.
rules.check: No use of universal minutes per panel without station-and-product validation.

rules.name: Board sheet layout, CNC cuts and yield
rules.logic: 2D nesting of wall-side board shapes with openings and kerf, grain/rating constraints; purchased sheets from nesting and supplier carton rules.
rules.check: No net area÷nominal sheet area without layout yield; record scrap and reusable remnants.

rules.name: Insulation kitting by cavities and module
rules.logic: Σ approved cavity polygons by insulation thickness/density minus prohibited voids; cut plans and pack yields from supplier specifications.
rules.check: Density and fire performance validated, panel installed layers not double counted.

rules.name: Fastener quantity and robotic fastening path
rules.logic: Count fasteners from approved engineered joint schedule; derive operation waypoints, speed limits, tool time and inspection; procurement rounds to boxes.
rules.check: Never determine structural screw pitch from architectural area; account for board layers and edge distances.

rules.name: Finite-capacity RMU robotic line scheduling
rules.logic: Schedule each operation on named constrained resource with setup, cycle, changeover, shift calendar and OEE; lead time = finish of last required operation − authorised release.
rules.check: Do not add parallel station cycle times as elapsed takt; bottlenecks and queuing control throughput.

rules.name: Manual handling, assembly and staging labour
rules.logic: Σ task durations by panel family×skilled crew size plus changeovers/staging/movement derived from approved time studies.
rules.check: Do not add labour twice when fully loaded machine rate already includes operator.

rules.name: Work-in-progress and buffer inventory
rules.logic: Compute WIP via routing release/finish schedule and batch sizes; working-capital holding from inventory days × material value.
rules.check: Buffers must respect floor space and fire limits; carrying cost belongs finance/overheads only once.

rules.name: Factory electricity, compressed air and consumables
rules.logic: Σ machine power/load factor×operating_hours and compressor energy from validated duty cycle; consumables from station recipes.
rules.check: Avoid billing utilities separately when already included in loaded machine hourly rate.

rules.name: Wall panel robotic sequence and openable cuts
rules.logic: Approved production recipe sequences framing, board placement, fastening and openings cutout; machine and manual time per critical resource path.
rules.check: Check hole/cut location against MEP and structural paths; sequencing must match equipment FDS.

rules.name: Integrated MEP wall manufacturing kit
rules.logic: From frozen panel MEP ID list count sleeves, conduits, boxes, pipes and install/test task hours; components assigned MEP material owner.
rules.check: Production labour charged here; materials priced once within MEP BOM unless commercial package says otherwise.

rules.name: Structural framing inspection and first-article
rules.logic: First article per qualified new panel family, material spec, machine setup and revision; periodic sampling from approved quality plan.
rules.check: Nonconforming first article prevents automatic batch release.

rules.name: Panel weight, centre of gravity and lifting pick points
rules.logic: Panel weight = Σ exact approved material masses + embeds and included fixtures; CG from mass-weighted component coordinates; lifting hardware by approved rigging.
rules.check: Structural temporary lift load combinations, safe lifting capacity and orientation approved.

rules.name: Precast footing mould volume and casting cycles
rules.logic: Concrete net volume from approved footing solids less voids; casting cycle includes prep, inserts, pour, vibration, finish, strength release and stripping.
rules.check: Demoulding governed by achieved concrete strength and approved handling rules.

rules.name: Precast wall/slab moulding and concrete volume
rules.logic: Σ non-overlapping approved panel/slab solids less designed ducts/openings; form face and edge areas separately per unique panel family.
rules.check: Do not count same volume twice between hollow-core slabs and walls; cast-in sleeves/embeds tracked.

rules.name: Reinforcement and insert kit BOM
rules.logic: Σ bar cut lengths×certified kg/m, laps/couplers separately; inserts count via structural connection schedule and element IDs.
rules.check: Design laps, cover, tolerances and handling inserts reviewed by engineer.

rules.name: Precast mixing, batch yield and production losses
rules.logic: Planned wet concrete volume = Σ approved mould net volumes + controlled overfill/waste from batch history; number batches = ceil(volume/batch capacity).
rules.check: Loss is factory supply ledger, not installed concrete; moisture adjustments mix design-controlled.

rules.name: Curing resources and release strength
rules.logic: Curing occupation duration from verified maturity/strength criteria and actual process capacity; schedule blocking until verified lift/strip release.
rules.check: Fixed curing days are only provisional absent verified mix and conditions.

rules.name: Bathroom pod frame and base fabrication
rules.logic: Per approved pod variant explode steel/precast base BOM and wall frame members, including lifts, penetrations and changeover time.
rules.check: Structural pod interface approval and transport dimensions required.

rules.name: Pod fixtures, services and finishes station routing
rules.logic: Expand complete pod assembly BOM into electrical/plumbing/waterproof/tile/fixture recipes; finite capacity by workstation and repeat family.
rules.check: In-pod MEP/finish material priced only once in pod or discipline owner; no duplication.

rules.name: Factory pod pressure, electrical and wet-area testing
rules.logic: Test suite = required hold tests per pod and product family; test hours from method statements; fails create explicit rework and retest jobs.
rules.check: A failed test blocks dispatch; mandatory evidence recorded per pod QR ID.

rules.name: Material incoming inspection and heat/lot traceability
rules.logic: Material receipts classified into lots; inspection sampling from quality plan and supplier approval; each accepted lot linked to consuming panel/pod.
rules.check: No unapproved lot used in load-bearing or rated assemblies.

rules.name: In-process and final inspection sampling
rules.logic: Sampling count = inspection-plan-defined sample size by family/lot/risk; capture measurements, deviations, photos and signoff.
rules.check: Life-safety items may need 100% inspection; sampled items must follow approved plan.

rules.name: Rework, scrap and yield reporting
rules.logic: Actual scrap = issued material − accepted product embodied material − reusable remnants − accounted returns; rework direct jobs via NCR tickets.
rules.check: Do not roll automatic contingency into measured BOM or double count scrap and purchase waste.

rules.name: Preventive maintenance and changeover allocation
rules.logic: Allocated maintenance/setup = qualified scheduled downtime hours by machine/work-centre divided across actual machine-utilisation drivers or specific batch.
rules.check: Do not double charge maintenance embedded in loaded hourly machine rate.

rules.name: Factory indirect labour and overhead absorption
rules.logic: Approved cost pools × causal drivers (machine hours, labour hours, space/time) with cost accounting controls; no per-m² blanket duplicate.
rules.check: Reconcile total absorbed costs to approved ledger pools, excluded double-loaded machine rates.

rules.name: QR genealogy and digital as-built handover
rules.logic: Create unique immutable QR record per shipped component, linking approved design, BOM, actual materials, test records, packing and dispatch.
rules.check: Dispatch blocks missing as-built/QC/lot lineage.

rules.name: Production batch optimisation and mixed orders
rules.logic: Cluster compatible approved families subject to machine, setup, colour/board-type constraints; schedule minimises changeovers without violating project priority.
rules.check: Do not pool unlike project specs or traceability lots without signoff.

rules.name: Factory lifting/handling resource occupancy
rules.logic: Σ crane/forklift moves by load/route plus rigging setup/inspection and handover time; shared forklift hours allocated to actual work orders.
rules.check: Hard limit on equipment/rigging SWL and access conflict; stop unsafe operations.

rules.name: Panel packaging, A-frame and dunnage
rules.logic: 3D packing assigns each accepted panel/pod to rack/crate by dimensional/orientation/load limit; rack-days = out-of-factory-to-return duration.
rules.check: Do not charge same rack as purchased and rented; protection included once.

rules.name: Pod weatherproofing and shipping seals
rules.logic: Packing kit quantities per pod variant from approved temporary weather closure schedule and interface protection requirements.
rules.check: Avoid charging weather-tight permanent envelope twice; inspect factory QC at loading.

rules.name: Truck/container 3D load planning
rules.logic: Constrained bin packing by actual packed 3D dimensions, axle loading, allowable mass, centre of gravity, segregation and unload sequence; trips integer.
rules.check: Volume utilisation alone is not sufficient; every load plan checked by logistics engineer.

rules.name: Load restraint, lifting, lashing and inspections
rules.logic: Restraint systems and lashing count from approved load-securing plan, applicable accelerations, mass/geometry and attachment ratings.
rules.check: Restraints cannot be inferred solely from number of panels; pre-dispatch photos required.

rules.name: Domestic transport kilometres and tariff
rules.logic: Route distance × approved carrier tariff by payload class and vehicle type; add tolls/delivery wait by contracted conditions.
rules.check: Road access/legal height and delivery time window verified; no invented route kilometres.

rules.name: International shipping and landed cost
rules.logic: Landed cost = freight + port handling + packing + insurance + brokerage + verified duties/taxes under selected incoterm; avoid embedded tax double count.
rules.check: Import fees depend on jurisdiction/ruling and must be supported by current quotations/rates.

rules.name: Oversize cargo permits and escorts
rules.logic: Each oversize/overweight load validated against route jurisdiction envelope; charge actual permit/escort obligations by trip.
rules.check: Oversize category and permits cannot be calculated without specific route rules.

rules.name: Fleet and delivery time-slot scheduling
rules.logic: Actual dispatch schedule includes round-trip travel, waiting, loading/unloading and return rack legs; carriers and sites capacity constrained.
rules.check: Avoid assuming a vehicle can serve conflicting delivery windows.

rules.name: Site offloading and temporary laydown
rules.logic: Laydown area by packed load footprints + access aisles for dwell period; offload hours from crane/forklift handling plan.
rules.check: Site accessible ground bearing/clearance verified; do not presume unlimited staging area.

rules.name: Delivery acceptance and damage inventory
rules.logic: Receive scanned item IDs with condition photos, QR status and damage reports; exceptions linked to actual repair/replacement jobs.
rules.check: Missing parts cannot be silently counted as installed; damaged items blocked.

rules.name: Crane selection and lift feasibility
rules.logic: For each panel/pod evaluate actual load + rigging, radius, boom configuration, wind/load chart and ground conditions; derive crane time by lift schedule.
rules.check: Feasibility requires competent lifting engineer and site-specific lifting plan.

rules.name: Lift cycle and crane scheduling
rules.logic: Cycle = rig/prep + hook/hoist + swing/travel + alignment + unhook + return; simulate shared crane constraints and workface availability.
rules.check: Panel erection cannot exceed site ability to align and temporarily brace.

rules.name: Precast isolated footing set, level and grout
rules.logic: Cycle by footing = bedding/set-out check + lift + elevation adjustment + alignment + temporary stability + approved grouting/cure wait.
rules.check: Placement levels/tolerances and connection design approved; foundation ground bearing confirmed.

rules.name: Precast tie beam and LGS foundation connection erection
rules.logic: Count unique tie-beam placements and bolted/embedded connection sets from approved detail; hours by lift/fit-up/torque inspection cycle.
rules.check: No standard screw/bolt count for unengineered tie-beam; as-built torque log required.

rules.name: LGS panel erection and permanent fixing
