rules.logic: Installation time = positioning + temporary bracing + connection prep + approved fastening + quality verification per unique panel.
rules.check: Fasteners from engineering, not panel count alone; site joints distinct from factory fasteners.

rules.name: Precast wall/hollow-core erection and grouting
rules.logic: Count unique lifts, designed bearing supports, grout joints and permanent connections; programme includes closure strength prerequisites.
rules.check: Require structural temporary stability, supports and approved installed load path.

rules.name: Bathroom pod set and service hookup
rules.logic: Pod cycle = lift/position + anchor + service connections + functional tests + finish interface closure; component parts uniquely linked to pod.
rules.check: Factory pod services must not be priced again as full site supply.

rules.name: Façade panel and roof module installation
rules.logic: Install productivity from panel count/complexity, access, module weight and connection schedule; cutting and rework jobs explicit.
rules.check: Rated façade/roof fixing and fall protection checked; no generic installed m² rate for complex geometry.

rules.name: Temporary bracing, props and support removal
rules.logic: Temporary works component counts from approved erection sequence and stability design; rental duration from erection to release event.
rules.check: Never release props before signed stability/strength checks.

rules.name: Site access scaffolds, platforms and MEWPs
rules.logic: Equipment from planned workfront reach, height, duration and personnel capacity; rental days on critical path incl. mobilisation/demob.
rules.check: Avoid charging scaffold in both façade subcontract and shared preliminaries.

rules.name: Installation crew shifts and productivity
rules.logic: Σ approved installation task durations × trade-specific crew count, plus explicitly scheduled travel/site idle periods.
rules.check: Do not apply factory throughput to site productivity; separate planned and earned hours.

rules.name: Site material handling and horizontal transport
rules.logic: Task volumes by piece weight/distance/handoffs and approved handling equipment; avoid double counting crane offloading.
rules.check: Route and hoist capacity constraints reconciled to programme.

rules.name: Demurrage, detention and standby exposure
rules.logic: Cost = actual or scenario standby hours×contractual rate; conditional exposure from delivery and release dependencies, not assumed certain.
rules.check: Disclose risk allowance separately from committed direct transport cost.

rules.name: As-built scanning, survey and punch-list handover
rules.logic: Count uniquely commissioned assemblies by ID; generate as-built geometry, test records, corrective action closure and handover package.
rules.check: Cannot mark complete if acceptance checks failed or scope exceptions unresolved.

rules.name: Rack return/reverse logistics and waste removal
rules.logic: Reverse cargo load plan for racks, crates and scrap; trip counts by weight/volume and authorised recycling/destination.
rules.check: Deduplicate rack return cost already embedded in carrier commercial terms.

rules.name: Delivered-and-installed price reconciliation
rules.logic: Direct cost = uniquely owned material + factory operation + transport + site install + distinct tests + project overhead; selling price via declared markup or gross margin, not both.
rules.check: Reconcile every billable cost_line to exactly one cost owner; no unpriced omissions or missing-as-zero.

rules.name: Machine-supported profile whitelist
rules.logic: Allow exactly FDS profile variants as machine DESIGN catalogue: 64 mm x 0.70 mm x 37 flange; 92 mm x 0.75 mm x 40 flange; 152 mm x 1.20 mm x 40 flange. Engineering approval is a separate required gate.
rules.check: Reject unlisted profile for line estimate; machine support does not certify structural use.

rules.name: Assembly application mapping
rules.logic: Map 64 mm to pod-wall design intent, 92 mm to interior and 152 mm to exterior per FDS. Use only project-approved assembly configurations for load-bearing classification.
rules.check: Do not equate exterior designation with load-bearing capacity; prohibit auto-upgrades by depth alone.

rules.name: Structural approval ledger
rules.logic: Effective assembly = profile SKU + steel grade + gauge + spacing + bracing + opening detail + sheathing + fasteners + load case + code + approval revision.
rules.check: Never mark FDS variant as approved without signed calculation/drawing tied to identical parameters.

rules.name: Panel dimensional admissibility
rules.logic: FDS design envelope: width in {2380,2440} mm; height <= 3200 mm; minimum safe height = UNCONFIRMED; other configurations require approved machine validation.
rules.check: Block machine-ready job where minimum safe height unknown for affected short panels; independent transport handling constraints.

rules.name: Gross/net wall takeoff
rules.logic: gross wall area = polygon measured surface; net surface = gross - approved deductible openings; retain both gross/net per board/wall measurement code.
rules.check: Overlapping/duplicate openings flagged; opening deductions depend on material method not global rule.

rules.name: Panel segmentation and repeats
rules.logic: Partition approved wall into feasible panel widths/heights respecting openings, transport, maximum mass, lifting datum and erection sequence; optimize repeated geometries.
rules.check: Do not split across engineer-defined joints or critical load paths; preserve panel identity/revision.

rules.name: Stud count by segment
rules.logic: N = 1 + ceil(clear straight run / maximum approved spacing) for a simple uninterrupted run; adjust for returns, edge studs, openings, structural doubling and intermediate supports using engineered member schedule.
rules.check: No automatic stud spacing from architectural drawing; engineer must set gauge/spacing for loads and span.

rules.name: Stud developed cut lengths
rules.logic: Sum individual member centerline lengths from engineered panel model adjusted for tracks, clearances, lap and fabrication cut rules.
rules.check: Measure every manufactured member; not wall height times overall stud count if staggered openings.

rules.name: Top/bottom tracks
rules.logic: Total cut-list track lengths along partitioned wall base/head paths excluding approved breaks, overlaps and splice geometry.
rules.check: No automatic inclusion of embedded track where another division owns connection.

rules.name: Double/jamb/triple-stud packs
rules.logic: Count jamb/king/trimmer/reinforced studs from structural opening detail and deduplicate overlapping framing at adjacent openings.
rules.check: Missing signed jamb schedule -> provisional rate only; block manufacture.

rules.name: Header and lintel built-ups
rules.logic: Explode approved header/lintel assembly into specific profiles, lengths, connection plates and screws per opening and design span.
rules.check: Do not infer header solely from nominal opening width.

rules.name: Sill/cripple/king-stud zones
rules.logic: For every window, derive sill track, cripple studs above/below and required member lengths from approved detail geometry.
rules.check: Cross-check count against opening schedule and elevation; no 2D overlap double counts.

rules.name: Shear, strap and bridging quantity
rules.logic: Count bracing lengths, straps, blocking and shear elements from engineered lateral-load/bracing layout only.
rules.check: Architectural geometry insufficient for bracing design; exclude from approved BOM unless engineered.

rules.name: Hold-downs, anchors and base fixing
rules.logic: Count approved anchors/hold-down assemblies at member endpoints and bracing ends from engineered connection schedule; quantity by unique anchor ID.
rules.check: Validate anchor edge distance, substrate and tolerances; assign foundations ownership once.

rules.name: LGS member-to-member fasteners
rules.logic: Quantity = sum(fasteners in each approved connection detail × connection occurrences); deduct manual temporary screws where included in final schedule.
rules.check: Do not count manual and robotic screws twice; robot dimples do not set screw count without design.

rules.name: Connection compression/dimple features
rules.logic: Count swage/compression and dimple operations by manufactured member geometry and approved joint schedule.
rules.check: Reject duplicate/mismatched stations, length mismatch, unsupported operation types.

rules.name: Board layer and side ownership
rules.logic: Compute sheathing per face/layer from approved assembly; FDS board-placement automation is ONE FACE; any additional opposite-side closure requires separate approved workstation/routing.
rules.check: Block assumption that FDS robot automatically boards both sides; reconcile finishing trade scope.

rules.name: Board cut sheets and waste
rules.logic: Layout panel surfaces against approved board stock sizes, joint rules, edge offsets and opening cuts; purchased sheets = ceil(required cut sheets / pieces per stock).
rules.check: Record reusable remnants separately; enforce screw edge-distance constraints.

rules.name: Fastening on side flanges and field
rules.logic: Separate robotic side-flange first-stage screws from remaining full-face screw pattern; count unique IDs and check specified spacing/edge rules.
rules.check: Collision between saw path and screw positions; closure after MEP inspection.

rules.name: Cavity insulation volume and packs
rules.logic: Insulation net cavity volume = sum(eligible cavity widths × clear heights × thickness) less defined obstructions; purchase in standard packs plus cut losses.
rules.check: Do not count areas filled by steel or large MEP cavities as solid rockwool volume.

rules.name: Thermal bridge/fire/acoustic assembly compliance
rules.logic: Check every assembly against project fire resistance, acoustic target and thermal design; add required layers only from tested/approved assembly.
rules.check: Incompatible gypsum/cement or untested membrane -> block approval.

rules.name: MEP penetrations and member notches
rules.logic: Count service crossings from coordinated BIM; notch/hole operations only where machine-supported and engineering-permitted.
rules.check: Any structural member penetration outside approval -> engineering exception, never automatic cut.

rules.name: Floor joist/trimmer assemblies
rules.logic: Expand approved joist spacing, span and edge details to member cut list, bridging, hold-down and support connections.
rules.check: No sizing from plan area alone; deflection/vibration/fire check required.

rules.name: Roof truss/rafter assemblies
rules.logic: Generate approved truss member schedule plus bracing, joints, purlins and support components from signed truss designs.
rules.check: Roof pitch geometry is not an adequate basis for structural member selection.

rules.name: Steel mass from developed member lengths
rules.logic: steel_mass = sum(developed_profile_cross_section_area × cut_length × steel_density) by SKU; cross-check certified kg/m of actual roll form.
rules.check: Nominal web × thickness alone is inaccurate for folded profile with lips/corners.

rules.name: Coil nesting and length yield
rules.logic: purchased_coil_mass = gross_cut_length_mass / measured_nesting_yield with offcuts recorded by SKU/heat.
rules.check: Do not add a second arbitrary waste percentage after nesting accounting.

rules.name: Panel tolerance and mass verification
rules.logic: Check built panel dimensions, squareness, weight, fastener pattern and board type against signed specification before release.
rules.check: Blocked if actual panel mass exceeds validated handling system; trace failed inspections.

rules.name: Configuration and recipe revision lock
rules.logic: Freeze engineered assembly version, panel ID, drawing revision, cut list, fastener recipe and board pattern as one immutable manufacturing job.
rules.check: Change after release forces affected cut lists and all downstream estimates to recompute.

rules.name: Assembly-to-rate mapping
rules.logic: Explode fully into unique procurement items; unit cost from approved rate-card SKU, location, effective date and currency; classify provisional when rates missing.
rules.check: No default zero cost; show unpaid rate items as exceptions.

rules.name: Design code jurisdiction selector
rules.logic: Apply project-design authority and applicable cold-formed steel code edition; map certified details to selected jurisdiction.
rules.check: No cross-country copying of approved stud spacing without verifying applicable code and load.

rules.name: Machine recipe eligibility
rules.logic: Accept panel job only if profile, board type, size, hole geometry and installed-side plan are supported by signed recipe and plant operating limits.
rules.check: FDS 64/92/152 variants and one-face boards are design intent; unsupported job routes to manual/provisional.

rules.name: Roll-form cut-length workload
rules.logic: Operations = each individual member cut from approved CNC list; per-operation time from actual roll-form machine log.
rules.check: FDS describes preprocessing, not actual throughput; no assumed time rate.

rules.name: Dimple/compression feature workload
rules.logic: Count each dimple and connection compression coordinate uniquely per cut-list member; job timing from validated machine recipe.
rules.check: Check tolerance, collisions and unsupported operation codes; separate from robot screw cycle.

rules.name: U-shaped manual frame pre-assembly
rules.logic: Task minutes = sum(observed member placement + alignment + temporary fixing) by member count, opening complexity and operator skill.
rules.check: Use first-article observations per configuration; temp screws must not conflict with robot path.

rules.name: Temporary fastening quantity
rules.logic: Count standardised preassembly temporary screws by approved recipe; identify those also forming final design connection schedule.
rules.check: No double counting in total fastener BOM; FDS calls for minimum manual screws.

rules.name: Frame loading using assisted manipulator
rules.logic: Duration = verified pick/transfer/align/fixture-ready time by geometry and panel weight class.
rules.check: No assumption that one operator or all weight classes are supported without trials.

rules.name: Fixture guide setup and first-off inspection
rules.logic: Setup time per fixture geometry + first-off dimensional verification; amortize by consecutive batch count, not every panel.
rules.check: T-slot guides manually adjustable; operator verification required.

rules.name: Dual KUKA robotic front-frame fastening
rules.logic: station_t = validated dual-robot scheduling result for remaining fastener positions plus approach, feed and inspection overhead; do not simply divide screws by two.
rules.check: Collision-free path and tool clearance; torque/presence monitoring only if implemented and verified.

rules.name: No-clamp alignment constraint
rules.logic: Validate panel position within fixture-guide tolerances; reject out-of-square frame rather than correcting via unapproved robotic program.
rules.check: FDS describes guide-based clamp-less strategy; actual sensing/tolerances TBD.

rules.name: 180-degree first flip
rules.logic: t_flip1 = observed infeed + secure via opposed conveyors + 180 rotation + release + outbound convey.
rules.check: Conveyor load limit, swept volume, operator access; count station once.

rules.name: Reverse-face frame fastening
rules.logic: station_t = scheduled second-side fastener operations by two-robot recipe plus overhead and feed delays.
rules.check: Ensure screws completed on first face not duplicated.

rules.name: Robotic board pick and place
rules.logic: t_pick = robot picks × observed vacuum pick/place/verification cycle for full vs pre-cut boards.
rules.check: FDS states cement board for 152 and gypsum board for 92; 64 treatment needs approved recipe.

rules.name: Side-flange initial fixation
rules.logic: n_side = approved preliminary side-flange screw positions, excluding those later re-run in full fastening.
rules.check: Count two synchronized mechanisms but model critical cycle through tested synchronous scheduling.

rules.name: Full-face remaining fastening
rules.logic: n_field = unique specified face fixing locations - locations already fixed at stage 4; robot time from verified programmed path.
rules.check: Sequence required before cutting openings; collisions and offsets reviewed.

rules.name: Opening perimeter cutting
rules.logic: Cut length = sum actual CNC toolpath lengths around openings plus lead-ins, including plunge/disposal operations, by material thickness.
rules.check: Do not use opening area to represent saw time; reject unsupported small radii or material.

rules.name: Dust extraction and scrap management
rules.logic: Dust collector demand by saw-on duration; removal/reset time per measured bin-fill threshold.
rules.check: Ensure dust control and safety interfaces validated; maintenance downtime charged once.

rules.name: Second flip to MEP orientation
rules.logic: t_flip2 = tested infeed/rotate/unload time, using board-down/frame-up panel orientation.
rules.check: Board damage and bending risk; cannot assume same cycle as bare-frame flip.

rules.name: Four-conveyor MEP routing and bypass
rules.logic: Assign panel-specific MEP activities to four independently staffed conveyor stations; model queue and bypass decisions.
rules.check: FDS allows asynchronous work; do not set line takt equal to simple sum of four station times.

rules.name: Electrical wiring and MEP fixtures install
rules.logic: Sum time by conduit runs, boxes, cable drops, penetrations, device terminations, test actions; use measured task standards.
rules.check: Any missing coordinated MEP design -> allowance, not fabricated exact time.

rules.name: Rockwool fitment manual operation
rules.logic: Minutes = cavity count × observed cut/fit rate adjusted for obstacles, panel size and access.
rules.check: Avoid multiplying all panel area by blanket installed minute rate when obstruction varies.

rules.name: Undefined board closure / downstream operation
rules.logic: FDS jumps from stage 8 to stage 10: station 9 is UNSPECIFIED; reject presumed second-board robotic closure or missing QC routing until supplier clarifies.
rules.check: Must create action item: confirm stage 9, second-face closure, QC checks and staffing.

rules.name: A-stand rack robotic unloading
rules.logic: t_stack = validated robotic pick/transfer/place/verify per panel weight and rack location.
rules.check: Two alternating stacking zones in FDS; actual safe lift envelope must be proved.

rules.name: Rack changeover and capacity
rules.logic: racks = ceil(total_panels / validated_panels_per_rack by mix); rack-change time from exchange observations and parallel-zone schedule.
rules.check: Do not infer rack capacity from flat panel area; do not charge transport rack twice.

rules.name: Station-specific time distributions
rules.logic: For each station derive per-panel time distribution from timestamped commissioning trials split by product family/complexity; store mean, median, P80 and sample size.
rules.check: Do not label untested FDS design takt as achieved production cycle.

rules.name: Bottleneck and throughput
rules.logic: Effective capacity constrained by slowest resource or simulated queue under routing and downtime; base capacity on station availability and shift minutes, not sum-of-station averages.
rules.check: Explicitly model asynchronous four-conveyor stage, changeovers and waiting.

rules.name: Changeover by variant mix
rules.logic: Setup burden = sum(measured changeovers between adjacent recipe/profile/board types); optimize sequence subject to shipment priorities.
rules.check: Use sequence-dependent costs, not fixed setup cost per panel.

rules.name: Rework, rejection and scrap feedback
rules.logic: Rework = repeat station/crew actual hours × loaded rates + replacement material + lost line time; attach defect code and panel ID.
rules.check: Separate first-pass yield from cycle time; no blanket scrap if actual known.

rules.name: Panel manufacturing digital passport
rules.logic: Bind job revision, panels, member list, machine operation locations, QC, workcell logs and rack ID through persistent panel UUID.
rules.check: Revision mismatch blocks station execution; manual overrides are signed and audited.

rules.name: Machine access and safety stop states
rules.logic: Log safety interlocks, curtain interruptions, maintenance stop and resulting lost productive minutes; no bypass in production.
rules.check: FDS safety conceptual; plant safety acceptance required prior to production.

rules.name: Precast unit type and ownership catalogue
rules.logic: Catalogue pad, isolated footing, strip/tie beam, wall, slab, stairs, pod base; tag SUB or SUPER by installed position.
rules.check: Same embedded steel connector must be assigned to either precast or LGS cost owner, not both.

rules.name: Concrete geometric net volume
rules.logic: cast_volume = solid approved unit model volume - cast-in voids + approved camber/edge build-ups; separately show finish-mould allowances.
rules.check: Do not calculate volume solely from gross bounding box for ribbed/hollow units.

rules.name: Reinforcement cut-bend-schedule
rules.logic: steel kg = sum(rebar bar-mark count × approved cutting length × certified kg/m), including lap, bends and hooks per BBS.
rules.check: No rebar kg per m³ proxy in an approved procurement BOM.

rules.name: Cast-in anchors and plates
rules.logic: Count embeds, threaded sleeves, lifting anchors, magnets, wall connectors and plates by approved unique embed IDs and procurement kits.
rules.check: Flag insufficient cover, clash, anchor capacity or double-counted LGS connector.

rules.name: Precast footing bedding/leveling grout
rules.logic: Bedding volume from surveyed support area × engineered bed thickness less voids; grout purchased by batch yield and measured waste.
rules.check: Geotechnical bearing/design input mandatory; no generic footing thickness or uplift capacity.

rules.name: Tie beam and junction assemblies
rules.logic: Precast beam volume + reinforcement + connection components by approved detail; split field grout and temporary support to site ledger.
rules.check: No substituting LGS tie beam without signed structural adequacy and connection design.

rules.name: Mould type mapping and setup
rules.logic: Match shop geometry to mould type; setup minutes = last measured cleaning + insert/form change + dimensional check by configuration.
rules.check: Incompatible geometry, mould tolerance or insufficient mould life requires separate tooling quote.

rules.name: Mould capacity and utilisation
rules.logic: Capacity_mould = floor(usable mould minutes / elapsed cycle occupation) per mould bank with actual parallel curing and demould rules.
rules.check: Do not equate crane labour time with full mould occupancy; weather/cure impacts.

rules.name: Mould wear and replacement accrual
rules.logic: Cost = approved mould service cost / certified expected remaining casts; maintenance downtime modelled separately from consumables.
rules.check: No infinite mould life; supplier warranty not necessarily actual life.

rules.name: Concrete batch reconciliation
rules.logic: batch_volume = sum(project pour volumes + measured production losses); assign batch ticket ID and concrete mix approval to cast group.
rules.check: Reject unsupported mix grade; reconcile poured volume to ordered/batched volume.

rules.name: Rebar cage and embed installation
rules.logic: Minutes = measured cage handling + tied joints + embed placement + inspections by unit/rebar complexity.
rules.check: Lifting and embed fit conflicts held for engineering approval.

rules.name: Cleaning/release agent/prepour QA
rules.logic: Observed cleaning, release application and first-off check by mould surface and finish requirement.
rules.check: No pour until check of formwork dimensions, embeds, reinforcement and covers completed.

rules.name: Pouring/vibration/finishing time
rules.logic: Total labour = observed placing + consolidation/vibration + screeding/trowelling time by volume, access and finish class.
rules.check: No fixed m³/hr for complex cast-in embeds without time-study benchmark.

rules.name: Curing temperature, duration and test gate
rules.logic: Earliest safe demould = first time strength test/maturity method reaches approved release criterion, respecting mix and ambient profile.
rules.check: Fixed 24h cure without validated strength gate prohibited.

rules.name: Curing throughput and mould bottleneck
rules.logic: Total achievable units constrained by mould occupancy, cure-zone slots, demould equipment and shifts; model each as separate resource.
rules.check: Reported target capacity not actual proven output; bottleneck evaluation mandatory.

rules.name: Demould and lifting operation
rules.logic: Observed rig/hoist/release/inspect/transfer time using unit mass and lifting-point design.
rules.check: Demould only after QC release; lifting points engineered.

rules.name: Yard stacking and handling
rules.logic: Space/handling cost by footprint + accessible aisle + allowable stack levels × residence duration.
rules.check: Do not use theoretical maximum stack height without engineer/vendor approval.

rules.name: Concrete samples, dimensional and finish QA
rules.logic: Sample frequency by adopted standard/spec and approved QA plan; record compressive, dimensional, surface and embed results.
rules.check: Quarantine failed batches, reject nonconforming release strength.

rules.name: Precast reject/waste and remanufacture
rules.logic: Record actual rejected concrete volume + reinforcement + mould/labour loss + machine downtime by defect cause.
rules.check: No double application of project contingency and line reject multiplier.

rules.name: Hollow-core slabs outsourced/onsite
rules.logic: For hollow-core: approved span, depth, strand layout, void ratio, weights and supplier shop measurements; estimate supply/erection by unit schedule.
rules.check: Prestressing and fire performance require engineer and certified producer; do not generate from simple area.

rules.name: Wall-to-wall and wall-to-floor joints
rules.logic: Connection assembly explode by signed joint detail, steel, grout, bearings, sealer and weld/bolt quantities; owner factory vs site explicit.
rules.check: Avoid counting cast-in embed and site connector twice across divisions.

rules.name: Precast pod-base geometric/production recipe
rules.logic: Pod base concrete and BBS by approved design; batch grouping, form occupancy and handling time based on base size and configuration.
rules.check: Planning throughput goals require commissioning records, not embedded assumed standard cycle.

rules.name: Shared overhead crane and transport queue
rules.logic: Allocate crane lift events to casting, demould, yard and loading by actual scheduled occupancy; schedule conflict as delay not separate phantom cranes.
rules.check: Single event billed to exactly one cost line; prevent factory-vs-logistics duplicate.

rules.name: Steam/heat/vibration/plant utilities
rules.logic: Meter operating energy by concrete mix, curing method, equipment run time and verified measured conversion rate; assign to relevant cast batch.
rules.check: Do not assume steam cure is installed; use configured process only.

rules.name: Concrete batch-to-element passport
rules.logic: Link unit UUID, mould ID, pour batch, BBS, embeds, strength reports, cure, QA, lift and transport ID.
rules.check: Cannot ship without release strength, final QC and traceable lifting certificate.

rules.name: Shift paid vs available minutes
rules.logic: available_minutes = paid_shift_minutes - mandatory_breaks - planned_nonproduction; overtime separately categorized.
rules.check: Never treat 8-hour paid shift as 8 productive hours without records.

rules.name: Machine available vs productive minutes
rules.logic: machine_available = scheduled_machine_minutes - planned maintenance - unplanned stop - changeover - safety downtime; distinguish availability from production.
rules.check: Machine downtime cannot also be subtracted in labour utilisation calculation twice.

rules.name: Operation standard-time library
rules.logic: Standard minutes = observed median qualified performance time × documented allowances; version per SKU and complexity class.
rules.check: No unverified blanket min/m² on diverse panel assemblies.

rules.name: Time study sample quality
rules.logic: Store timestamped start/stop, panel class, crew size, repetition, deviation reasons and observer sign-off; compute median/P80 by group.
rules.check: Separate pilot/learning curve from stable production; minimum samples to be defined by process owner.

rules.name: Setup amortization per batch
rules.logic: allocated_setup_minutes_per_unit = approved total changeover time / actual planned batch quantity.
rules.check: Do not re-charge setup under each manufacturing operation and labour line.

rules.name: Complexity multipliers by activity
rules.logic: Adjust standard time only for validated classes (door count, MEP inserts, ceiling height, access); no arbitrary fixed factor.
rules.check: Review multipliers quarterly and by SKU; prohibit negative efficiencies without study.

rules.name: U-shaped preassembly staffing
rules.logic: Direct labour = frame-prep task minutes × assigned concurrent headcount / 60 by profile/openings mix.
rules.check: Station volume alone does not determine required crew; ergonomic max loads enforced.

rules.name: Robot cell operator attendance
rules.logic: Assign operator attendance minutes by robot station from actual operator tasks and concurrent machine coverage, not 1 operator per robot by assumption.
rules.check: Shared operators allocated once across cells with capacity conflict checks.

rules.name: Manual MEP labour standards
rules.logic: Sum approved activity minutes per device, cable run, sleeve, pipe fitting and test by qualified trade; allocate shared stations.
rules.check: No extraction of engineering design from incomplete architectural plan.

rules.name: Insulation and board touch-up labour
rules.logic: Manual cut/fit/touchup units × observed activity minutes with obstructed-cavity multiplier.
rules.check: Use separate rework ledger for corrections; do not duplicate finish work.

rules.name: Rebar preparation/bending productivity
rules.logic: BBS by shape, diameter and count mapped to measured cutting/bending/tie standard minutes.
rules.check: No kg/hr constant across heavily shaped bars without validated class.

rules.name: Mould cleaning/form setup productivity
rules.logic: Mould surface m² and insert count × relevant observed cleaning/adjustment unit rates plus setup.
rules.check: Mould work and cure waiting are not the same labour consumption.

rules.name: Concrete casting crew productivity
rules.logic: Casting labour by concrete m³, finish requirements, pour complexity and crew times from approved trials.
rules.check: Do not add batch plant operator hours twice under precast/plant shared operations.

rules.name: Demould and yard handling productivity
rules.logic: Lift/move/task event counts × validated crew attendance duration; occupancy depends on transport path and lifting limits.
rules.check: Do not confuse crane equipment hours with number of riggers × hours.

rules.name: QC/testing labour
rules.logic: Count prescribed inspections, sample tests, first articles and recheck actions × observed standard minutes.
rules.check: Inspection release status required; failed-unit rechecks as rework.

rules.name: Maintenance labour allocation
rules.logic: Allocate actual preventive/corrective work orders by line or asset running hours, tracked independently of production operator work.
rules.check: Maintenance staff not simultaneously fully assigned to all lines.

rules.name: Loading, packaging and dispatch labour
rules.logic: Panel/rack load and secure work tasks × validated crew standard for relevant rack/truck class.
rules.check: Shared logistics crew cost owner only one module; outbound truck operator separate.

rules.name: Panel erection labour productivity
rules.logic: Erection tasks by unique panel IDs, lift class, alignment, bolts, bracing and sealant; sum crew × observed attendance by workface.
rules.check: Height/site access/permit dependencies; no blanket panel/day rate.

rules.name: Precast site placement productivity
rules.logic: Count lift + alignment + connection + grouting events by unit mass/geometry and actual trial productivity.
rules.check: Grout cure is elapsed time, not continuous crew-hours; do not double lift.

rules.name: Pod placement and hookup productivity
rules.logic: Installed pods × observed per-pod positioning, levelling, structural fixing, MEP hookups and QA, classed by pod type.
rules.check: Pod-internal factory labour excluded from site installation labour.

rules.name: Workface congestion and access loss
rules.logic: Production impact = proven shift-standard deviation for scaffold, multiple trades and crane availability by workface; log reasons.
rules.check: Not an automatic arbitrary contingency surcharge if actually measured hours included.

rules.name: Weather and stoppage productivity adjustment
rules.logic: Expected loss from location seasonality/recorded shutdowns; keep as risk scenario separate from measured productivity.
rules.check: No fabricated weather allowance where records/plan absent.

rules.name: Skill and certified-role matrix
rules.logic: Map each operation to qualified trade and required simultaneous count; unqualified operator cannot satisfy certified task.
rules.check: Workforce availability and certification gates before release of production schedule.

rules.name: Concurrent crew and resource constraint
rules.logic: Peak people = max(sum(active nonshareable crew at time t)) over scheduled jobs, subject to cell occupancy and safety zoning.
rules.check: Cannot assign one worker simultaneously to two independent tasks.

rules.name: Overtime and shift premium
rules.logic: Labour cost = task paid hours × loaded base rate + legally applicable overtime premium + shift differential; separate regular vs premium hours.
rules.check: No universal labour rate across UAE/India/USA.

rules.name: Loaded labour rate by location
rules.logic: fully_loaded_rate = (wages + benefits + visa/insurance + paid leave + payroll burden + allocated direct employee costs) / true paid allocable hours.
rules.check: Currency and exchange-rate dates retained; distinguish site vs factory burdens.

rules.name: Labour cost allocation without duplication
rules.logic: Distribute activity hours to exactly one atomic cost owner via labour_activity_id; reconcile to timecards and payroll.
rules.check: No second labour charge within generic manufacturing cost/m² if direct hours already charged.

rules.name: Utilisation and OEE distinction
rules.logic: Labour utilisation = productive labour paid hours / allocable labour paid hours; machine OEE calculated separately as availability × performance × quality.
rules.check: Do not multiply labour and machine utilisation on same cost to create double penalties.

rules.name: Learning curve as scenario
rules.logic: Use measured mature standard only after commissioning; quote pilot learning cost separately by planned batch and evidence.
rules.check: No unverified future productivity improvements counted as achieved.

rules.name: Absence, leave and roster availability
rules.logic: Available trained crew = qualified roster - paid leave/absence - mandatory training; convert to deployable shifts.
rules.check: Workforce availability risk cannot be concealed by theoretical staff count.

rules.name: Bottleneck manpower optimisation
rules.logic: Run event/shift simulation to find minimum qualifying simultaneous headcount supporting bottleneck resources and takt; constrained by safety and skill requirements.
rules.check: Cannot derive by target output/ideal cycle alone; validate with trial.

rules.name: Task-based subcontract alternatives
rules.logic: Compare documented subcontract unit rate against equivalent internal task-hours plus equipment/quality costs under same scope and assumptions.
rules.check: Exclude subcontract scope from internal labour when selected.

rules.name: Direct rework and first-pass yield
rules.logic: Rework hours per unique defect ticket with affected part IDs; link material redo and waiting time to one cause.
rules.check: Do not include rework via both global markup and ticketed actuals.

rules.name: Source and approvals for labour standards
rules.logic: Each time standard stores observed sample set, author, factory/site, effective dates, variance, approval and version.
rules.check: Old standard marked superseded; variance triggers recalibration review.

rules.name: Quote confidence and sensitivity
rules.logic: Run scenarios on uncertain cycle time, yield, crew rates and setup; identify largest contributors to cost/takt uncertainty.
rules.check: No single false-precision production day/price without basis and variance.

rules.name: Factory takt and utilisation reconciliation
rules.logic: Target takt = available operating minutes / required good panels; required station effective cycle <= takt after OEE and quality loss, otherwise insufficient capacity.
rules.check: Flag infeasible output target rather than forcing workers or zero downtimes.

rules.name: Crew-dependent task duration
rules.logic: Elapsed operation duration = verified task labour-minutes / effective concurrently productive crew, subject to nonparallelisable steps and space limits.
rules.check: Never divide by crew count if task cannot run in parallel.

rules.name: Steel coil nesting yield
rules.logic: steel_net_mass_kg / approved_nesting_yield
rules.check: Calibrated nesting per thickness/width; avoid applying secondary flat allowance

rules.name: Board sheet nesting and offcuts
rules.logic: purchased_sheet_area_m2 - net_usable_board_area_m2
rules.check: Include cut-outs and retained reusable sheets separately; no blanket add-on over true nest

rules.name: Concrete batching and spillage
rules.logic: batch_issued_m3 - cast_in_place_m3 - returned_reusable_m3
rules.check: Separate design overpour from plant wastage, adjust for recoverable returns

rules.name: Rebar nesting and cut-length scrap
rules.logic: stock_issued_kg - accepted_installed_kg - reusable_stock_kg
rules.check: No inferred standard laps without engineering schedule

rules.name: Insulation and membranes cutting loss
rules.logic: purchase_coverage_m2 - net_installed_coverage_m2
rules.check: Overlaps in gross installed; waste only excess purchase

rules.name: Tile/stone pattern cutting loss
rules.logic: ordered_pack_area_m2 - installed_area_m2 - unused_returnable_area_m2
rules.check: Count manufacturer pack rounding and stock return credits

rules.name: Opening-cut material recovery
rules.logic: cutout_scrap_qty - credited_reusable_cutouts
rules.check: Credit recovery where documented

rules.name: Breakage in production or transport
rules.logic: approved_loss_qty by SKU and cause
rules.check: Do not add to initial quote unless evidenced allowance or priced risk; allocate one owner

rules.name: Site rework and rejected installations
rules.logic: approved_replacement_qty minus recoverable_qty
rules.check: Avoid simultaneous waste allowance and installation rework charge

rules.name: Minimum order quantities and purchase increments
rules.logic: CEILING(net_required_qty / supplier_pack_size)*supplier_pack_size - net_required_qty
rules.check: Surplus usable inventory is stock, not automatically scrap

rules.name: Scrap disposal and recycling credits
rules.logic: disposal_fee - documented_recycling_or_salvage_credit
rules.check: Treat recoverable scrap as separate ledger and do not drive negative physical volume

rules.name: Yield and variance ledger reconciliation
rules.logic: purchased_qty - installed_qty - reusable_stock_qty - disposed_qty - expected_WIP_qty
rules.check: Block unexplained material variance above approved tolerance

rules.name: Project establishment and preliminaries
rules.logic: SUM(approved_time_based_and_fixed_preliminaries)
rules.check: Link duration to schedule; distinguish installation direct labor

rules.name: Factory fixed indirect overhead recovery
rules.logic: approved_indirect_factory_pool * job_allocation_driver / total_driver
rules.check: Exclude plant direct utilities and direct labour already in manufacturing

rules.name: Corporate SG&A recovery
rules.logic: eligible_cost_base * approved_corporate_overhead_rate
rules.check: Single company overhead allocation, no duplication with factory overhead

rules.name: Factory depreciation allocation
rules.logic: qualified_machine_capex_depreciation / total_practical_capacity * consumed_hours
rules.check: If machine hourly rate already includes depreciation, zero separate posting

rules.name: Bid/performance bonds and insurances
rules.logic: approved_premium_and_bond_costs
rules.check: Excludes general policy expense already in corporate overhead

rules.name: Working capital and financing charges
rules.logic: qualified_drawdown * effective_rate * approved_tenor_fraction
rules.check: Commercial estimate only; finance approval and actual funding required

rules.name: Currency conversion controls
rules.logic: FOREIGN_CURRENCY_COST * approved_fx_rate
rules.check: Do not confuse FX exposure allowance with current translated cost

rules.name: Escalation provision
rules.logic: eligible_uncommitted_cost * escalation_assumption_by_period
rules.check: Do not escalate contracted fixed vendor rates

rules.name: Engineering uncertainty contingency
rules.logic: SUM(weighted_approved_risk_allowances)
rules.check: Contingency is visible line; not hidden in material wastage

rules.name: Warranty/defect reserve
rules.logic: eligible_project_revenue_or_cost * approved_reserve_rate
rules.check: Do not also apply same reserve in installation rework

rules.name: Permits, testing and authority fees
rules.logic: SUM(required_fees_by_jurisdiction)
rules.check: Identify tax/duties outside base if not overhead; single owner

rules.name: Approved subcontract inclusion reconciliation
rules.logic: supplier_total - externally_allocated_direct_components
rules.check: Flag supply-and-install double charge before quote

rules.name: Rate card version and supplier evidence gate
rules.logic: NO_NUMERIC_PRICE_IF_UNAPPROVED_RATE_VERSION
rules.check: Prevent stale rates and missing rate entries from passing as zero

rules.name: Final cost ledger reconciliation
rules.logic: SUM(category_postings)==SUM(unique_atomic_cost_transactions)
rules.check: Every transaction exactly once; taxes separated

rules.name: External agent eligibility
rules.logic: agent_contract_active AND territory_and_client_eligible
rules.check: Unapproved party blocks accrual and quote provision

rules.name: External commission basis
rules.logic: commissionable_base = CONTRACT_DEFINED_NET_REVENUE
rules.check: Exclude VAT/sales tax unless explicitly contractually agreed and legally permissible

rules.name: External commission rate
rules.logic: eligible_base * contracted_percentage
rules.check: Rate never inferred from default industry percentage

rules.name: Tiered agent commissions
rules.logic: SUM(tier_band_revenue * applicable_tier_rate)
rules.check: Deterministic tier bands; test threshold boundaries

rules.name: Commission floors and caps
rules.logic: MIN(MAX(calculated_commission,approved_floor),approved_cap)
rules.check: No floor or cap applied without signed terms

rules.name: Milestone and payment accrual
rules.logic: approved_commission * milestone_earned_fraction
rules.check: Separate pricing provision from actual payable

rules.name: Agent tax, withholding and compliance
rules.logic: APPLY_COUNTRY_SPECIFIC_VALIDATED_TAX_RULES
rules.check: Do not treat tax withheld as extra commission

rules.name: External agent conflict and duplicate check
rules.logic: SINGLE_ACTIVE_COMMISSION_CONTRACT_PER_ELIGIBLE_SCOPE_OR_APPROVED_SPLIT
rules.check: Escalate overlapping introducer claims

rules.name: External commission reversal
rules.logic: -previously_booked_unearned_commission
rules.check: Maintain immutable adjustment journal

rules.name: Internal incentive plan approval
rules.logic: plan_effective AND role_eligible AND project_eligible
rules.check: No automatic entitlement without signed policy

rules.name: Internal commission eligible base
rules.logic: company_policy_defined_margin_or_revenue_metric
rules.check: Do not silently use same base as external agent

rules.name: Individual commission allocation
rules.logic: incentive_pool * approved_credit_share
rules.check: Sum shares 100% for allocated opportunity

rules.name: Project pool cap and floor
rules.logic: MIN(MAX(calculated_pool, floor),cap)
rules.check: Missing cap must not be assumed

rules.name: Profitability-based eligibility
rules.logic: release_only_if_approved_contribution_margin_threshold_met
rules.check: Commission contingent on policy-defined margin after returns

rules.name: Internal sales payment trigger
rules.logic: accrue_when_contract_or_collection_condition_met
rules.check: Distinguish forecast accrual and payroll payout

rules.name: Incentive clawback and returns
rules.logic: reverse_incentive_on_credited_or_cancelled_revenue
rules.check: Audit reversible journal; follow labour/payroll law

rules.name: Payroll burden and withholding
rules.logic: PAYROLL_ENGINE_CALCULATES_JURISDICTION_RULES
rules.check: Prevent payroll taxes and gross commission duplication

rules.name: Internal commission conflict resolution
rules.logic: ONE_APPROVED_TEAM_CREDIT_ALLOCATION_PER_SCOPE
rules.check: Store immutable approval history

rules.name: Selling-price basis and tax
rules.logic: net_sales_ex_tax = gross_contract_price - discounts - nonrevenue_taxes
rules.check: Tax excluded from margin denominator unless financial policy explicitly states otherwise

rules.name: Markup versus margin interpretation
rules.logic: markup = profit/cost; margin=profit/net_sales
rules.check: Prevent confusing 20% margin with 20% markup

rules.name: Additive sales-percentage price solver
rules.logic: price=(base_cost+fixed_commissions)/(1-target_margin-external_rate-internal_rate)
rules.check: Valid only if all three rates apply to identical net sales base

rules.name: Markup-based price solver
rules.logic: price=(base_cost*(1+markup)+fixed_commissions)/(1-external_rate-internal_rate)
rules.check: Different concept from net-sales margin: quote setting chooses one

rules.name: Multi-basis commission price solver
rules.logic: numerical_solve_price_for_target_profit_after_all_variable_payments
rules.check: Use iterative solver for tiers/caps/marginal profit-based commissions; convergence gate

rules.name: Minimum target contribution margin
rules.logic: (net_sales - fully_loaded_cost - commissions)/net_sales >= floor
rules.check: Do not publish below floor without written override

rules.name: Discount approval workflow
rules.logic: discount_amount <= approved_limit_by_role
rules.check: Discount recalculates commissions and achieved margin

rules.name: Price rounding and reconciliation
rules.logic: round_to_currency_minor_unit_then_recompute_achieved_margin
rules.check: No arithmetic residual hidden in overhead

rules.name: Scenario pricing sensitivity
rules.logic: EVALUATE(rate_fx_yield_crew_duration_margin_scenarios)
rules.check: Store base, pessimistic, optimistic without overwriting baseline

rules.name: Quote validity and escalation
rules.logic: quote_expiry = approved_validity_end; reprice_if_expired
rules.check: Block old quote acceptance without revalidation

rules.name: Profit waterfall and audit
rules.logic: net_revenue - sub - super - finishing - mfg - waste - log - install - OH - ext_comm - int_comm
rules.check: Profit displayed only once; do not add target profit as incurred cost

rules.name: Estimate to actual gross contribution reconciliation
rules.logic: actual_contribution_margin - quoted_contribution_margin
rules.check: Variance by SKU/rule/assembly, lock prior quote versions

quality_tests.check: All original 430 source rules retained exactly once by ID
All 11 categories present and each rule has one primary category
A component appears at most once in active cost ledger for each physical cost nature
Vendor turnkey quotations suppress overlapping direct labour/material/transport entries
Unresolved engineering or unverified drawing quantity blocks approved quote
Nesting waste calculated after net quantity and not added twice
Machine time and direct factory attendance use compatible independent resources
Crane cost assigned either logistics or installation by policy, never both
Commission calculation handles rate changes, caps and different revenue bases
Simple pricing solver back-substitution reproduces target net-sale margin
Tax/VAT excluded from net-sales margin unless approved jurisdiction policy says otherwise
Rate changes/revisions freeze old quote and recalculate traceable delta
All approved quantities include drawing+revision+rule version and approver
Unknown price, member sizing or machine time yields null/exception, not zero
